Friend,
_**Last week, Joe Biden delivered one of the most disgusting speeches an American president has ever given.**_

He ran as a unifier. Now, Brandon is saying to the vast majority of the country that disapproves of him that they're a threat to the republic.

Governor Ron DeSantis said it best:

_**Joe Biden is the American Nero.**_

He is a failed leader and his smear campaign against half of the country is nothing more than division.

He dodders, he lashes out, he labels anyone who dares to dissent from the Regime a fascist - but at the end of the day, his policies are why Americans reject him.

**Biden has:**
* Caused record setting inflation
* Flung open the southern border letting in dangerous drugs
* Embraced the reckless defund the police agenda
* Colluded with teachers' unions to keep kids out of school

So _**OF COURSE**_ people are going to be upset by all the wreckage he's left in his wake. That doesn't make them threats to democracy - that makes them human beings with a pulse.

It's long been said that the President of the United States is whoever is feeding Biden's teleprompter. Well, they've made it clear that people who dissent from his policies are somehow second-class citizens.

They've shown that on top of vilifying those who disagree with him, they are willing to mobilize the administrative apparatus of government to go after people they don't like.

Those 87,000 new IRS agents weren't hired to look into Brandon's political pundits - they're in place to audit the middle class!

Under Governor DeSantis's leadership, Florida is leading the fight to defend citizens from the Biden Administration's destructive agenda and unconstitutional overreach.

But we need to hold Biden accountable for his actions. This November is a referendum on his policies.

_**_[Governor DeSantis needs your support to continue our fight against the Brandon administration and ensure that we Keep Florida Free. clean_body: | | Friend, Today we learned Phil Scott has begun declining debates, including one at Castleton University. name: Rev. Raphael Warnock
subject: I'm proud to serve
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |
---
Friend: From a young age, my parents taught me what it meant to be of service to others. My dad was a veteran, small businessman, and preacher. My mom worked hard to raise my siblings and me and instill in us the belief that we could do anything we put our minds to.

Today, I'm proud to serve the people of Georgia in the Senate – but my work doesn't stop there. I serve as the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the spiritual home of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. **Sometimes folks ask me, "What is it like to walk in Dr. King's shoes?"** I always tell them I've never tried.** ****We don't need to walk in his shoes; we need to stand on his shoulders and meet today's moment. **

Understanding that my service doesn't stop at the church doors is a big part of why I ran for Senate in the first place. Now, I'm fighting hard to keep Dr. King's dream of justice and equality alive in Washington.
**But I'll be honest:_CNN_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection – and new polls show this race is neck and neck. The only way I can defend my seat and win our critical fights for justice is with your help. [I'm personally asking: Will you give $5 or more right now to help me keep Georgia blue, defend our Senate majority, and build a better future for our country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50379275/365653454/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3948-fr-in&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGUzNzJhYi0wYzJmLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BIbPSBzx8XTm6sSVALnW6ApismC0nDQLJM2jd1PhKPA=)**

Polis and his best friend Joe Biden are crushing our energy industry - doing their best to put the oil and gas industry out of business while they implement their green new deal here in Colorado and drive gas prices up.

Polis has failed to protect farmers, ranchers, and property owners' mineral and water rights.

Here's my message to Jared Polis:
> **Rural Colorado deserves more than just a photo op and press conferences. They want you to answer for the destruction of their industries that YOU have caused.
>
> This state is made up of more people than those who exist in Denver and Boulder, Mr. Governor. You are severely misreading what's happening in our state, and I WILL be a voice for ALL Coloradans, especially rural Colorado, whose voices deserve to be heard. **

disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican National Committee
body:
Letter enclosed | Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219163:J0bhBwVN_:m:1:3253819041:698746C2F3484D4ADCF7B72C0B6FAF7A:r)

Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219163:J0bhBwVN_:m:1:3253819041:698746C2F3484D4ADCF7B72C0B6FAF7A:r)**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219163:J0bhBwVN_:m:1:3253819041:698746C2F3484D4ADCF7B72C0B6FAF7A:r)

**[Will you help us win back our Republican majority?>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219163:J0bhBwVN_:m:1:3253819041:698746C2F3484D4ADCF7B72C0B6FAF7A:r)**

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

**[Please contribute $45 RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats' destructive agenda. >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219163:J0bhBwVN_:m:1:3253819041:698746C2F3484D4ADCF7B72C0B6FAF7A:r)**

Sincerely,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219163:J0bhBwVN_:m:1:3253819041:698746C2F3484D4ADCF7B72C0B6FAF7A:r)
Kristi Noem
Governor of South Dakota

Letter enclosed | Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)

Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)

**[Will you help us win back our Republican majority?>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)**

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

**[Please contribute $45 RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats' destructive agenda. >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)**

Sincerely,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)
Kristi Noem
Governor of South Dakota

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219172:6_mY9wVVN:m:1:3331421248:13B7DB9F41CA99D5933FFDDF32193065:r)**

name: Kristi Noem
subject: Personal Letter for You
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican National Committee
body:
Letter enclosed | Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)

Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)

**[Will you help us win back our Republican majority?>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)**

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

**[Please contribute $45 RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats' destructive agenda. >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)**

Sincerely,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)
Kristi Noem
Governor of South Dakota

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219199:JAyI_wVgN:m:1:3317145305:461E249A9E4A6E977963084354942D09:r)**

body:
Letter enclosed | Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)

Dear Patriot,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)

**[Will you help us win back our Republican majority?>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)**

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

**[Please contribute $45 RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats' destructive agenda. >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)**

Sincerely,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)
Kristi Noem
Governor of South Dakota

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61219512:JbshFwVNj:m:1:3299561967:BD05C7A9F40B0C2D02A9F5E33A9C4998:r)**

Friend,

You know what makes me furious? When leftwing activists claim Jesus Christ would support socialism, student loan bailouts, or a big government.

And to make things worse?

Most of the time, these leftwingers don't believe in Jesus. They're simply _weaponizing Christianity to justify their political beliefs_.

Here's the thing: I don't care if the attack comes from the left or the right. If somebody uses the name of God to justify aggression, I'm going to stand against it. What are you going to do?

**My name is Dr. Norman Horn, I founded the Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) with the mission to make the Christian case for free markets and free people.**

Christians are an integral part of defending liberty, preserving morality in our culture, and opposing the evils of empires.

In the words of Benjamin Franklin, _" Rebellion to Tyrants is Obedience to God."_ More importantly, we should heed the words of Acts 5:29, "We ought to obey God rather than men."

You and I are responsible for making the Christian case for liberty to our fellow believers, non-believers, and countrymen. The Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) is leading this cause and equipping Christians the knowledge, resources, and courage to execute on this mission.

[_**Please join the Libertarian Christian Institute by making a donation of any amount. My goal is to raise $10,000 from online supporters to spread our message of Faith and Freedom. Please click here or below to donate:**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zit4g2b8e0b1s6ubljhpal06oomhuqo90jndnju8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68oj5clh2bs)

[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zsfkddjvtukmulg7bp8gf7hurac92q17a2n3rk88_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68oj5clh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4ui03g6m40f4me3gtnf8fli9b4tb5pa3vkdcigg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68oj5clh2bs)

The Libertarian Christian Institute believes liberty is the most consistent expression of Christian political thought.

**This is what we believe and are fighting for: **
* Christians must root their beliefs in Scripture.

* A free society must abide by a Non-Aggression principle - The Bible gives us clear instructions to reject violence and force to change hearts and minds. This applies to the government as well.

* Individual liberty is critical to achieving peace and prosperity.

* Healthy social institutions matter for human flourishing - Meaning we must not surrender our schools, churches, or even businesses to Woke social justice activists and the enemies of liberty.

* Christian theology affirms the ideas of free market capitalism: Jesus instructs us to respect each other's property, to never STEAL from our neighbor, and to be productive citizens.

God has given us everything we need to make the _Christian_ case for a free society.

However, I fear our country will continue falling into the grasp of socialism if you and I fail to advocate for our ideas and the values laid out for us in Scripture.

[_**Friend, I am calling on you to help me spread our message and begin changing the hearts and minds of both believers and non-believers with our mission. Please support the Libertarian Christian Institute by clicking here to make a donation. **_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6hl3406vbkte89ea4j14imdg25b1rd0ngq19mn8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68oj5clh2bs)

How do we spread the _Christian_ message of free markets, free people, and a free society?

Here is everything the Libertarian Christian Institute is doing to have an impact:

* **The Libertarian Christian Institute Podcast:** We produce a weekly podcast reaching THOUSANDS of people across the country. We discuss current events and tackle the Christian perspective on things such as School Choice, student loans, Sound Money, and the pro-life movement.

* **Our book, "Faith Seeking Freedom: Libertarian Christian Answers To Tough Questions":** We've published a book to make the Christian case on all the difficult debates of the modern day... Why abortion is evil, why taxation is theft, and why believers must reject socialism.

* **Online Content & Events:** Our belief is that we must reach NEW audiences and folks who may not agree with us on everything. We desire to change hearts and minds... not preach to the choir. LCI publishes online content constantly and presents at conferences in order to reach people with our message.

Here's the big problem with all of this...

I can't spread our message without your help.

**The battle for liberty and my faith in Jesus Christ represent a merger of two of the most important things in my life. I am a Christian with a heart on fire wanting to spread both the Gospel and the message of liberty. **

The Libertarian Christian Institute does not have billionaires funding our operations... I am counting on the support of believers from across the country donating online.

Please help me reach my goal of raising $10,000 so LCI can continue spreading our message.

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zan31uidqp30n0svo095v2pelera3r47t13efro8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68oj5clh2bs)

[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zutp0qlrnhavjo0je3nmq9alr9pnlipdq03lhtdg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68oj5clh2bs)

Thank you so much, Friend.

It would mean the world to me if I earned your support for LCI's mission today.

Let's make the Christian case for a free society together.

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2pqtkkmubavoj8om9s3vqdkke9h38b1mq5p63b0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68pj4c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u2pn2slkelin8d5i6uoe1p3gm6or2t70e5hm4o5mckrm9olmm6p60srl6qo7edtnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjicooj5cr0s1pb2phks2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8iv0)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4e86tu7qdis7u2taag5o5jrsf88sq4ur535sat0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdj68pj4c9h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

body:
Friend, are you an extremist? Odds are that if you opposed COVID lockdowns, think parents should have a say in the education of their own children, and support free speech for everyone... [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6315%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=51Kw2RjCoqObzKE4ybOdWw&sysid=1)

---
Friend, are you an extremist?
Odds are that if you opposed COVID lockdowns, think parents should have a say in the education of their own children, and support free speech for everyone... _Biden thinks you are._
He said so in a speech last week that has every First Amendment-loving conservative fired up. _Including me._ **[STAND WITH RAND >>](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75250%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xI2IAPWaNfbnbbOQryVNgg&sysid=1)** Biden’s targeting of conservatives is a HUGE red flag.
* _We’ve already had a glimpse into the left’s vision these past few years of COVID tyranny._
* _We watched as big gov teamed up with big tech to ban our videos on YouTube and block our tweets contradicting their COVID narrative._
* _We even witnessed the launch of an Orwellian censorship project called the “disinformation governance board!” (Thank god, that failed!) _

_** **_ **There’s no doubt that the current political environment is the most anti-free speech, anti-progress of science, and anti-conservative one we’ve ever seen.**[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75251%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8jIrUO56DSA2HiOGV2X%2fFQ&sysid=1) _** **_ _But this mob-style intimidation is not how you solve anything._ If you look at the biggest issues America has overcome, we did it with open debate and conversation - the actual opposite of what this administration is doing. _** **_ _Every American should be able to practice their political beliefs without fear of government-sanctioned backlash. _ _** **_ If you agree, please chip in now to help me fight censorship and encourage debate.
---

It will pour fuel on the fire of this inflation crisis. **And it will DOUBLE the size of the IRS by hiring 87,000 new agents!** _Who do you think they’re going to have in their sights?!_ _**[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[It’s time to STAND UP and FIGHT BACK against this insanity >>>](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33663%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WWLBbUWN4qicOirTqPCVuA&sysid=1)**_ _**My position is clear: We need to ABOLISH THE IRS.**_ Enough is enough of this failed bureaucracy’s harassment of hardworking Americans.

Enough is enough of their targeting of conservative organizations and individuals. **[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5hzTTfwL%2fhcopT4AvZ79w&sysid=1)[Please support the critical work of my friends at Truth and Courage PAC, as they train an army of grassroots conservatives to SAVE AMERICA this November.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33664%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sTBxK7KEmsdBBFwUDgDUdA&sysid=1)**

body:
https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject [https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject]
September 8, 2022
Dear friend,
We are pleased to endorse Emily Fulmer for Collierville Alderman Position 4.
Emily is an educator and activist and has long worked to make our community better. She's a founder and board member of Collierville Community Justice [https://www.colliervillejustice.org/] , a diverse and intergenerational coalition of Collierville residents working for racial and economic justice. She's also member of NAACP Collierville and a union member with United Campus Workers-CWA Local 3865 [https://ucwtn.org/] .
Emily is seeking to help build a "Collierville for All" [https://www.collierville4all.com/] , running with the vision that everyone deserves representation in local government no matter where they live, what they look like, or how much money they make. She's running a unique campaign--one that's focused on the issues impacting everyday people like affordable housing, healthy communities, and investment in young people.
JOIN TVP IN SUPPORT OF EMILY FULMER FOR COLLIERVILLE ALDERMAN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpformartin]
Emily is also prioritizing election reform. If you don't know already, Collierville has an at-large voting system, which means that there are no district-specific representatives. Without representation specific to each community, some neighborhoods are bound to be left behind. In Collierville, this has resulted in never having a Mayor of Alderman elected from the south side of town, where Emily currently lives. This has to change.
We need every community represented in government and we need someone like Emily in office. She's running a tough campaign and will need all the support she can get. We hope you'll consider supporting the election of more progressives in the suburbs, starting with Emily Fulmer for Alderman.
Click this link to support Emily Fulmer for Collierville Alderman Position 4 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpformartin] . Half of what you contribute will go directly to Emily's campaign and the other half will go to turning out voters in November.
Thank you for your support,
Tennessee Voter Project Staff

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWQvdrhhNX

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWQvdrhhNX

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, our digest of liberty, to
reach millions more Americans.

Increase the number of citizens (especially younger Americans)
enrolling in our free online courses, such as "Constitution 101:
The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope," and our newest course, "American
Citizenship and Its Decline" with Victor Davis Hanson.

Launch additional Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter
schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, our American
classical K-12 curriculum (including the new Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum) to thousands more American teachers and
homeschoolers.

And your
generous support is critical to our success. Here's why...

Hillsdale
College conducts its educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty-as it does all of its work-while refusing to accept one
penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants or loans.

So, to
expand this effective program, we will need thousands of gifts
between $25 and $100. This is the range in which most supporters
give. We will also need a significant number of $500 to $1,000
donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

We
urgently need your help.

You can
safely and securely renew your support using this link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60728552:WQvdrhhNX:m:3:2532013465:C5E65939A2C27CFB6FC39F2780A805DB:r

As the
forces of anti-Americanism redouble their own efforts to
undermine informed patriotism in our schools and our culture, and
to subvert constitutionalism in our government, we must engage
them ever more aggressively-including on the central battlefield
of education.

That's
why I hope you'll make your most generous gift in this critical
year for America.

Every
dollar you can give will help expand our Project to Defend
Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

Thank you
for your generosity. I hope you'll stand with us. Together, we
will work to preserve freedom for future generations of

They don't even realize anymore that they are being **PLAYED LIKE PUPPETS** by lobbyists and Big Corporations.

I am NOT a career-politician, nor am I beholden to ANY lobby or corporate agenda.

Let me tell you who I am and what I stand for.

**I believe in our constitution and the inalienable RIGHTS given to WE THE PEOPLE!**

Our nation is under attack by leftist democrats who would love nothing more than to continue their rampage, destroying our country, our values, and our very way of life!

**In Congress, I will stand up against communist agendas and FIGHT for our conservative values. I 'll fight for your right to bear arms, to secure our borders, and to stop the senseless spending creating RECORD inflation.**

I am on a mission to create change, give the PEOPLE back their voice, and create a future for your children and mine!

Someone NEEDS to take a stand for free-market principles and pro-growth policies while keeping OUR RIGHTS at the forefront of the conversation.

**But I CAN 'T do this alone.** Much like we all rely on our communities for support, I am relying on YOU to help make this much-needed difference in Washington.

Peter,

**I cannot overstate the importance of the Senate race in Georgia.**

This is the country's closest and most competitive battle. In 2020, Democrats won the Senate majority because of runoff wins in Georgia, and we can't let that happen again. **The future of our nation will be decided by what happens in Georgia on November 8.**

In a moment, I am going to ask every American patriot - _no matter where you live_ - **[to get off the sidelines and support my conservative friend Herschel Walker.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224445:6PF0gwVN8:m:1:3317145305:46B1D00D3F260283490EF6CDDA15E3DE:r)** But first, you need to know why your help is so critical, Peter.
* Herschel's opponent, Senator Raphael Warnock, is the #1 fundraiser AND spender in the country when it comes to campaign dollars, **raising $64 MILLION this cycle and showing no signs of slowing down.**
* Senator Warnock votes 96% of the time with Joe Biden, including for open borders, less energy independence, 87,000 new IRS agents, and higher taxes.
* This race has been declared a "toss up," so it could go EITHER WAY. **[It's up to us to help Herschel move the needle even further to flip this seat back into Republican hands.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224445:6PF0gwVN8:m:1:3317145305:46B1D00D3F260283490EF6CDDA15E3DE:r)**

This race will be over in less than 70 days. We won't get this time back, Peter, and we need to do everything possible to ensure we reclaim the Senate majority and get America back on track.

**[I'm asking you to step up with $25 or more to help Herschel WIN this seat and FLIP the Senate RED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224445:6PF0gwVN8:m:1:3317145305:46B1D00D3F260283490EF6CDDA15E3DE:r)**

**Can I count on you?**

Thank you,

Peter, it's Alex, Trudy's campaign manager. This morning, I woke up, checked my phone, and realized something: **The 2022 midterm elections are exactly two months away from today.**
I've worked on campaigns for a while now. I've watched the days fly by faster and faster. I know that in this final stretch, summer is gone in the blink of an eye, and Election Day is right there in front of you. But it still comes as a shock every time.
So, as of today, we have just two months until Election Day.
We have just two months until the last ballots are counted.
We have just two months until this campaign is over.
**We have just two months until voters choose either progress and compassion or extremism and hate.**
Listen, voters are ready to hear Trudy's story, and they're ready to choose a senator who will fight for them every single day. **But to make this happen, we need the grassroots resources to ensure we can turn out the vote and reach the swing voters who will decide this election.** That means traveling to events, running ads, hiring organizers, knocking on doors, canvassing neighborhoods, and fighting voter suppression.

| | | |
---
**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
The _establishment_ thrives on the ignorance of the people. That is why we must do whatever it takes to _educate_ each other, _grow_ together, and _**mobilize**_ in order to _Restore Liberty_ & _Pre**serve America**_.

**I’d like to invite you** to a constitutional class I believe I'm __called__ to host. I will be announcing that class soon, so please be on the lookout.

This will be a _fun_ and _inspiring_ opportunity to _connect_ with other like-minded patriots here locally, _build_ meaningful relationships, and _rendezvous_ with our Founding Fathers to gain valuable knowledge of our country’s Constitution and its “original intent”.
Don't live in Montgomery County or Harris County? I've got your six... I will eventually be doing a separate class online at some point in the future.

That being said, let me leave you with this small nugget of wisdom...

It is __imperative__ that we understand the difference between positive rights and negative rights... **positive rights** are granted by the government while **negative rights** are rights that prevent others – above all, the state – from transgressing on you personally or on your property.

Negative rights are given to us by God and grant We The People power... and with great power comes great responsibility.

What kind of power?

The power of _self-governance_.

**In other words...** the Constitution doesn't grant us the right to self-governance; the Constitution _**recognizes**_ our right to self-governance.

And there _is_ a difference.

We live in a world today where people are blaming the Constitution for failing us when they _should_ be looking in the mirror.

Ouch.

Remember, **with great power comes great responsibility**.

This is why John Adams said, “ _Our Constitution was made only for a moral and religious People. It is wholly inadequate to the government of any other._ ”
Feel free to email with any questions.

_For Liberty,_

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z73ip194eihf8mf5tvjg2ct5tb4pi0fp7b7l96qg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdgmaor6clh2bs)

Dear Friend,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z641g4pon1n34j20jepocitgg3lr0scjd63ve8kg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdgmaor6clh2bs)**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvmm2r13ld2qh4ckvs80ivt2jrna9cqjc1uqdfuo_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdgmaor6clh2bs)

**[Will you help us win back our Republican majority?>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmsrnkcnr0c87qldjm4dqpk1tlpsrdfjsk5lfol0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdgmaor6clh2bs)**

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

**[Please contribute $45 RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats' destructive agenda. >>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z28dgu1dn18h3qbpm0j1b24htofgbst6vthiii20_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdgmaor6clh2bs)**

Sincerely,

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zav7safu8j9j5095ivph75m0811ijq5qh356hr80_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdgmaor6clh2bs)
Kristi Noem
Governor of South Dakota

The future of our nation will be decided by what happens in Georgia. |
---
Peter,

**I cannot overstate the importance of the Senate race in Georgia.**

This is the country's closest and most competitive battle. In 2020, Democrats won the Senate majority because of runoff wins in Georgia, and we can't let that happen again. **The future of our nation will be decided by what happens in Georgia on November 8.**

In a moment, I am going to ask every American patriot - _no matter where you live_ - **[to get off the sidelines and support my conservative friend Herschel Walker.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224418:Jg2NsvVEN:m:1:3253819041:0CF5BE9A28D0CA0C8BA5E8CD9D87A6D1:r)** But first, you need to know why your help is so critical, Peter.
* Herschel's opponent, Senator Raphael Warnock, is the #1 fundraiser AND spender in the country when it comes to campaign dollars, **raising $64 MILLION this cycle and showing no signs of slowing down.**
* Senator Warnock votes 96% of the time with Joe Biden, including for open borders, less energy independence, 87,000 new IRS agents, and higher taxes.
* This race has been declared a "toss up," so it could go EITHER WAY. **[It's up to us to help Herschel move the needle even further to flip this seat back into Republican hands.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224418:Jg2NsvVEN:m:1:3253819041:0CF5BE9A28D0CA0C8BA5E8CD9D87A6D1:r)**

This race will be over in less than 70 days. We won't get this time back, Peter, and we need to do everything possible to ensure we reclaim the Senate majority and get America back on track.

**[I'm asking you to step up with $25 or more to help Herschel WIN this seat and FLIP the Senate RED.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224418:Jg2NsvVEN:m:1:3253819041:0CF5BE9A28D0CA0C8BA5E8CD9D87A6D1:r)**

**Can I count on you?**

Thank you,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224418:Jg2NsvVEN:m:1:3253819041:0CF5BE9A28D0CA0C8BA5E8CD9D87A6D1:r)

Nikki Haley

P.S. We only need to flip one seat to end the Democrats' razor-thin majority. Herschel Walker will be our 51st Republican senator, but it will only happen if conservatives across the nation get off the sidelines and join his fight today. **[I'm ALL-IN for Herschel. Are you?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61224418:Jg2NsvVEN:m:1:3253819041:0CF5BE9A28D0CA0C8BA5E8CD9D87A6D1:r)**

**** Hi there, I’m a fourth-generation Coloradan. I grew up in Jefferson County and became the first member of my family to graduate high school and the first to earn a college degree. To help get by, I started cleaning houses when I was just 12 years old, worked behind the counter at a bagel shop, pushed carts at a grocery store, and waited tables at restaurant after restaurant to put myself through college. Growing up, the odds were stacked against me, but thanks to the support of Jeffco public schools, I was given a chance. I ran for office to make sure future generations have the same chance I did. And that’s the fight I want to take to Congress. I know that the policies we fight for every day make or break it for regular people like me. **[But listen, this race is one of just 30 toss-up races in the whole country — so I’m going to need your help. Letter enclosed | Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0f8c9q3b4g4k7dc6qqgb03uu441jvqa5e2mf628_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfeddgc1o78cph6iqe1cjmm4or6clmciqn4tbn6opmcsdjc9rb6oj5csr3actkcurt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6cc9kmmomfdr2coo71cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm4or5c9ge4pj24no)
Letter enclosed | Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4pif6pt2sv71l975hbu7ec3elbqknbk79u1db40_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)

Dear Friend,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhj1vjr277qlae1lc7o36akrfgja2ill7ndrturg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo6mdjs41f1aiho5bj0e97cdm1384g04m5pkmk2g_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)

**[Will you help us win back our Republican majority?>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbq7gioo6tnrfo85tnk92rhk0iaabjrhu7ipq0lg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)**

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

**[Please contribute $45 RIGHT NOW to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from the Democrats' destructive agenda. >>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za6nn8kqbfb26gujnj97mdet4e8jj182ep3eb9v8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)**

Sincerely,

[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze09bn5rlhin077594s45n9unjm46p2tgngk9390_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)
Kristi Noem
Governor of South Dakota

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z50sq9mgqqf2ju2q33cn9hkrbna48p2so8q9pmig_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim4o72cph2bs)**

name: Dale Wilcox
subject: Do you live in the worst city in America?
body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61225911:6QJQ6vVNS:m:1:3253819041:F4DADD6D8D7BAA4D384A02A5DA262F07:r)

Peter,

I know I don't have to tell you our borders are in shambles.

But I do have to tell you just how bad it's gotten.

Crime and chaos are taking over our country as we've never seen - have you seen the latest news reports?

Now, I don't know where you live.

One thing is for sure: we do not want any more of our cities to end up like Los Angeles or New York.

But I'm telling you about what's happening in America's worst sanctuary cities, because what started in Los Angeles and New York won't stay there.

The Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is fighting back against dangerous sanctuary city policies.

In fact, we've even published a document exposing the worst sanctuary cities in America!

But we need your help to stay in the fight.

[**So please consider making a tax-deductible donation of $22 or more to IRLI today, and while you 're at it, take a look at our exclusive new report, the Top 10 Worst Sanctuary Cities in America. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61225911:6QJQ6vVNS:m:1:3253819041:F4DADD6D8D7BAA4D384A02A5DA262F07:r)

**Anti-border politicians are doing everything in their power to bring this lawlessness to YOUR backyard.**

Oregon has a hotline set up for citizens to report violations of the state's sanctuary law.

You read that right.

It's not a hotline to report illegal aliens, but a hotline to report people for not doing enough to protect illegal aliens!

The city of Seattle demanded a $100 million COVID relief fund for illegal aliens from Washington state.

San Francisco's DA even created a special unit with the sole purpose of helping illegal aliens avoid deportation.

And that's just the tip of the iceberg.

**Now, I know if you 're the patriot I think you are, this all sounds crazy to you.**

It sounds like something that could never happen in America.

But that just isn't true.

My name is Dale Wilcox, and I've been with the Immigration Reform Law Institute for eight years now because I believe that our nation must be able to defend its borders and uphold the rule of law.

Our team has seen the effects of anti-border policies up close and personal - and that's why we work so hard to make sure the rest of America doesn't have to.

In every single sanctuary city and county across the country, Americans are in more danger.

It's no coincidence.

After all, when you reward criminals, lawlessness is sure to follow.

But I'm writing to you today because there's something you can do.

[**You can give a generous, tax-deductible gift of $22 or more to IRLI and give our attorneys the ammunition we need to take on the America Last legislators rolling out the red carpet for illegal aliens.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61225911:6QJQ6vVNS:m:1:3253819041:F4DADD6D8D7BAA4D384A02A5DA262F07:r)

To put it simply, the courts are our best bet.

We must be prepared to take on the legal battles that will shape our nation, and we can't do that without your help.

If you don't want the same reckless policies that overtook LA and New York introduced in your own community, I hope we can count on your urgent support.

Sincerely,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61225911:6QJQ6vVNS:m:1:3253819041:F4DADD6D8D7BAA4D384A02A5DA262F07:r)
Dale Wilcox,
Executive Director & General Counsel
Immigration Reform Law Institute

P.S. body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zt0er1qulvpqi5psju81e09ll65ms6uk4a3lmva8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkeq32t5nmeq33cjl61qn4cdkmoq37c3nm6or9ctn6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8shi62rmcsbm6hr6ashjeoorcolnmiqn2srmc1j61p70mlqe9cljcqqe7djh6urt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj1cr3c1p38phh6ipm6ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhm4or5c5hm8or24no)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zn33f4k337mr407tdpvj53tuc8fuc5b0qqu64bg0_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim2or4cdh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

Friend,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what’s never going to change.

**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=6bc9f5be7f71484c916252aa2318ef25&_e=UJQZeqHCOgNNS_iOBAzTdpT-jqD9E9O8POjCqZ5whDVAW7lqoCKOOy2npt-yY2snE-XLiosIww70DU2S6rR7aisrfyERyQA7UeU7laKYK6oPUIHSf7zjSvtsMo6GLKrdNNSq1C2rfuZxzD3V84oqtA4gaaaiYheUlS2RGDQ3X5VnC6J3v_k2cM6C3PAM-FFcUAbCfMMQUBX3oGH8zTWUjJ8QMnX9kQBYuIqtlowAx0Y-qnu6mxWiw9pMJwIjN73BzzrMIq2iph3r1AYdvepXPYnkzIFVezuXhvPRHrVCtnWdIgyrs6r7EMOSd0aRQ1O2gN-4T5WEhrbo1__JGkbzGHJWmXeUdKpEMqSrRvnHmepXXlR1lZ_FxW2ka7C2Jr-IZoCKG5PoIruxSFBCYepsRMt73y54-qZhTP7jTIsfuEtYHm2KIE9lcCbAckExSnMNLhI6Quoaqsuyy2KNJ_wzphFanL_OyJrGiKKsYtxol7jGDEeGJ9m-cdl2lSL8KG5k)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what’d I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state’s $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer’s Cabinet.

[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=6bc9f5be7f71484c916252aa2318ef25&_e=UJQZeqHCOgNNS_iOBAzTdpT-jqD9E9O8POjCqZ5whDVAW7lqoCKOOy2npt-yY2snE-XLiosIww70DU2S6rR7aisrfyERyQA7UeU7laKYK6oPUIHSf7zjSvtsMo6GLKrdNNSq1C2rfuZxzD3V84oqtA4gaaaiYheUlS2RGDQ3X5VnC6J3v_k2cM6C3PAM-FFcUAbCfMMQUBX3oGH8zTWUjJ8QMnX9kQBYuIqtlowAx0Y-qnu6mxWiw9pMJwIjN73BzzrMIq2iph3r1AYdvepXPYnkzIFVezuXhvPRHrVCtnWdIgyrs6r7EMOSd0aRQ1O2gN-4T5WEhrbo1__JGkbzGHJWmXeUdKpEMqSrRvnHmeo8-YgrhorLf7W8u7PplB7VVDFFyx_S3Rej7Bcc6Oour6QpAdaL-bgFW7FgxWVhd-vUZhwpFnITghY6RrdZuANp1oTeG7KJpl2uPcdht8COtkDbsmH568eGXZ-adzPRLiIywIPyta_UPdxHAXJlJpFI)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=6bc9f5be7f71484c916252aa2318ef25&_e=UJQZeqHCOgNNS_iOBAzTdpT-jqD9E9O8POjCqZ5whDVAW7lqoCKOOy2npt-yY2snE-XLiosIww70DU2S6rR7aisrfyERyQA7UeU7laKYK6oPUIHSf7zjSvtsMo6GLKrdNNSq1C2rfuZxzD3V84oqtA4gaaaiYheUlS2RGDQ3X5VnC6J3v_k2cM6C3PAM-FFcUAbCfMMQUBX3oGH8zTWUjJ8QMnX9kQBYuIqtlowAx0Y-qnu6mxWiw9pMJwIjN73BzzrMIq2iph3r1AYdvepXPYnkzIFVezuXhvPRHrVCtnWdIgyrs6r7EMOSd0aRQ1O2gN-4T5WEhrbo1__JGkbzGHJWmXeUdKpEMqSrRvnHmerUb4WkWhJu-diP3HBJzm28OzbBZdon1wwhCvhusmofYQ9wna-HPrjFztqff9FgZXlevPJed38XVaFO-JGP6Qfa5vVE0isC5D9pb_7-XX3OFIePCMY2xEHGbQt3RYYgJetAqf7_C32Mmi24y4RxF_Gr)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I’m always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That’s not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I’m going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children.**

That won’t change, I’d rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer’s Cabinet. Then, I got my biggest call. The call to help the people of Louisiana and America. Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. body:
New Hampshire Republican State Committee
Will you?

| Derek -- It is important now more than ever to unify our Republican Party here in New Hampshire. body:
I want to talk about why I’m paying very close attention to what happens in New Hampshire this fall.
| | |
---
Hi there, it’s Elizabeth Warren.
I want to talk about why I’m paying very close attention to what happens in New Hampshire this fall.
Right now, we’re just a couple of Senate votes short of ending the filibuster and passing federal protections for abortion rights — so if we expand our majority and hold onto the House, we can secure abortion rights nationwide as soon as January.
But that won’t be possible if we lose control of the Senate. That means we must defend every single Democratic incumbent up for reelection this year — including Maggie Hassan. The GOP has made her a top target, and right now, she needs our help to hold onto this seat.
**[That’s why I’m asking you if you can chip in to support her reelection campaign. Whatever you can give — $3 or $13 or more — will make a difference in keeping Maggie in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50407756/365771389/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=jtk1584-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODgwMDBhYi05NzJmLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MTXWFJKGgeadZ0iehzMYYxqfk6e2o2hGMfalx8sR7P4=)**
I’ve been proud to work shoulder to shoulder with Maggie to make progress on the priorities that matter most to American families. But our ability to protect the progress we have made and push for further action will come to a complete halt if Mitch McConnell flips just one seat and takes back the gavel in November.
McConnell’s vision for a Senate majority under his control is clear: radical, anti-choice, and obstructionist. We can’t let him make that vision a reality. We need Maggie’s voice and her vote in the Senate.
And she will need help from all of us. Because she won her last race by just 1,017 votes, the GOP is targeting her, and Maggie is in jeopardy of being replaced by a rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell’s radical right-wing agenda. We can’t let that happen.

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zib58b1ddm3v6ti2eh4ogs21fr1bf9gi53djlmc8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdimcpr4cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrj9obhm4oe2d32edqjaspn6spb4otgsdi69clme2or9oph6cob4tpnm1pbfcb0sv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6ptie9j32d5lmoo74sb661ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp2bs)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zv6aurigv0ophvb8efq71r13g2mgsojt74ttmsdg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdimcpr4cph2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

[ Note ]Alice -- Stacey Abrams' (un)official campaign dog

Hey Derek,

It’s Alice — Stacey Abrams’ (un)official campaign dog. I have a busy day
of chasing squirrels and napping so I’ll keep it quick.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220908_B1_NoteFromAlice_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=5093%2E1862389%2EMgLY6O ]The dog days of summer are almost over. And now, the final leg of our
campaign is starting. We need all paws on deck to reach out to voters to
elect one of my favorite humans, Stacey Abrams, to the governor’s mansion.
Can you throw us a bone and chip in $5 right now?

Here’s the deal: Brian Kemp (grr) is leading a dog-eat-dog race and
spending millions of bucks to howl lies about Stacey Abrams.

Everyone on Team Abrams is working like a dog to share Stacey’s message
and bury Kemp’s lies — they barely have any time to focus on their main
job of giving me belly rubs.

The good news is the plan to get Stacey to the governor’s mansion (and its
huge lawn) relies on taking me on long walks and car rides to reach
Georgians in every corner of the state — and then persuading, mobilizing
and helping voters cast their ballots for Stacey Abrams.

Marco

body:
The most persistent, damaging misconception about suicide is that people who attempt it have reached a point of no return
#

*** The following email is about the role of guns in death by suicide. If you or a loved one are contemplating suicide, please call or text the free and confidential National Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 988. ***
Friends -
Suicide is the untold story of gun violence in America. While firearms are used in just a small fraction of suicide _attempts_ , because they are so uniquely lethal, they are responsible for a majority of American suicide _deaths_.
The truth is, the most persistent, damaging misconception about suicide is that people who attempt it have reached a point of no return, and their deaths are inevitable.
The gun lobby has perpetuated this myth and vehemently denied any link between gun access and suicide. Instead, the NRA and other gun lobby groups has often suggested that without access to firearms, a person in a suicidal crisis would simply “find another way.”
The facts contradict this inevitability myth: the vast majority of people who attempt suicide survive, and go on to live out their lives without attempting suicide again.
And the data categorically shows that gun access is the most significant factor in states’ overall rates of suicide. Compared to other variables, gun access is the most correlated with suicide death on an individual level as well.
Responsible gun policy reform is a critical component in any effort to save lives from suicide in America.
By enacting policies to limit at-risk people’s access to firearms during moments of crisis, we can reduce suicide rates and save lives.
September is Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, so we thought it important to share this information, and to ask you to help us fight to change our laws that will save lives.
