name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2a0c7k047a20hbdj5o764qg26sifubjk4blgn9o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uapj0tpkm5rm5dr369qj8phjm2oeddlkm5oj6ob5e5rj5dpnc4obec76e2r32s37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjicooj9ddkcupb4phkc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3c9hmao72c9g649fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoi6pc5i92vfa6lpol380jftv3goiumaal6nfbf8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpk84dctb0ll01lp4pe984eos4uqe5tmboj5f5oo_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp9u5niu45439217unf829ifn289lhfo34v2kk6g_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7qmsuka52qt5obeib1mn2rj8ebh9g1o4msi00do_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf47s382d0nqmieg6akls61q6blkc3bf3nbc3e1g_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo2c5rci0217bm36ieecters6fojmm8t3rct9hg8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb0v4m8vb0m49gh1ui091bsagip3f46hrghf1rgg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqr431ot334dat3b45d8nkvqb7r6kkeqbeo1am10_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmlsqck0ltv53us6n5g4heri0frr6d4lgnaqpafg_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1i48m3l8tjerh5of52jgf3l0l42vv7dmhj7lm7o_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zouak8lhrcifjveamtihdl283ber54or29fa4f48_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcin3cmdpvimbieiatp6qqjq0tvlltec0k06p998_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7l0b1mcb4otn0puugghu3psg2d32hm2cq7adkao_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmuh73vj0ij04qb02ucl701q4mvn9v0umie91ejo_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztiskqihimt5k2bq4kp08ejkf1dg4bfa8pv08r2o_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z05qijv5otcjq09f1b1mh60i3jjtcplfqcjtalv8_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0qjkb1nagdlmh0h7fdpu9v3ck1r6ug9qu7tv540_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdsm5u080gqri1120bd2hg7s4bqlfej4nd24du90_rp22sh2s8i66or2cdim1oj2c1h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation
If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for American Action News, [please use this preferences page](http://e.americanactionnews.com/prefs/9z2z4o3no74quh73krihpac8t6i6k7rmnq172fl3klo).
625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

Let's Save American Energy Together!

Friend,

I'm thrilled to announce that our Saving American Energy Tour Documentary is finally [here](http://links.wesleyfortexas.com/u/click?_t=fd5d6e7aa0334e7ebb096a39dc496016&_m=95e8696a594a4858b61f5343d1ce76c8&_e=gCKDQAPEHlDq2OgFHK5dHoKV8QnttwojCCiAKvpfkTnVxJ3FocHo7g242pLkygzn16ispga87n-iJBs4k-klP-ZoZiDstmCxFG_KmRk_1hZcpsJ5wUAUadAmpF4dfjYsCbyO-rTqVy2-CspEdh2TosZlHAAMZbQDaIgw__d1uI7ZKcN3NDzxHImSc_n68hC1SJ_9F3z2_KiZV-wQap35gItaft54UIMA0CDR6lwt9dP67pu8bkokYPJ61aQC7dD7)! Season 1 includes stops in New Mexico, Houston, West Texas, and the Gulf of Mexico and I can't wait for you to see it. To watch, please visit [SavingAmericanEnergy.com.](http://links.wesleyfortexas.com/u/click?_t=fd5d6e7aa0334e7ebb096a39dc496016&_m=95e8696a594a4858b61f5343d1ce76c8&_e=gCKDQAPEHlDq2OgFHK5dHoKV8QnttwojCCiAKvpfkTnVxJ3FocHo7g242pLkygzn16ispga87n-iJBs4k-klP-ZoZiDstmCxFG_KmRk_1hbcJCN9BnaiAjTYh772GMaci48J_PjGAvhciDoFQ53rdLyv7FqzebUUUqs1hD_ozixTP8XZTB6aG8uAGbqcQK1t0H1bmO42tVxA-W-Spvq4gVIjLBZUF5xa2oC4AWVmWptlzs7qxCCp5yEI3Q9JD70i)

[](http://links.wesleyfortexas.com/u/click?_t=fd5d6e7aa0334e7ebb096a39dc496016&_m=95e8696a594a4858b61f5343d1ce76c8&_e=gCKDQAPEHlDq2OgFHK5dHoKV8QnttwojCCiAKvpfkTnVxJ3FocHo7g242pLkygzn16ispga87n-iJBs4k-klP-ZoZiDstmCxFG_KmRk_1hbNwJrf6nyab7b3qahgqDZvHiSdJB75MJPR_6wG1219EIO2Bk2YUiKGIxGybrrp4XtzwTceNA40TYX7HPhDo75hN8hqEz_o1VxFRc_L-FnWtz1_r7b0DuDDg0Kfc8t2g_fKXRRBiCMV1f4OvMUWH_GJ)

After 7 months of long arduous work, [Season 1 of our documentary is now live](http://links.wesleyfortexas.com/u/click?_t=fd5d6e7aa0334e7ebb096a39dc496016&_m=95e8696a594a4858b61f5343d1ce76c8&_e=gCKDQAPEHlDq2OgFHK5dHoKV8QnttwojCCiAKvpfkTnVxJ3FocHo7g242pLkygzn16ispga87n-iJBs4k-klP-ZoZiDstmCxFG_KmRk_1ha-rwNV1p326sre8qY_Du4o-MwB-CtoTni1UL0eer1lCT2EtHHqPrZjEr5Qye4_dshrV0k5EdEwOHePdLfTt45DdskuXe9INjm2IGFP0iuXRiAHnJP8d7e404LbkuV8hBnVSjGHWmYHY7c4kluunBbJ), which details my experiences touring Oil and Gas assets throughout New Mexico, Texas, and the Gulf of Mexico. The brave men and women of America's Energy industry should never be taken for granted as their hard work is responsible for the fuel in our cars, AC and heating in our homes, and the clothes on our backs. Everything we own is a direct or indirect product of fossil fuels, and without these brave patriots, our way of life would cease to exist.

Our country needs leaders willing to unapologetically stand up for American energy independence, and as the future Congressman for the Energy Capitol of the World, I will do just that.

Respectfully,
Wesley Hunt

body:
You are one of our loyal supporters, so you know how Judicial Watch is working hard every day to fight for the rule of law and against public corruption and unlawful government secrecy

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

You and I...indeed all Americans...are facing _a worsening crisis of uncontrolled illegal immigration ...and every bit of its many serious impacts...both long and short term_.
President Joe Biden has reversed former President Donald Trump's efforts to secure our borders...from halting construction on the border wall to "pausing" deportations, to reviving the disastrous Obama era DACA ("Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals") amnesty program called "pathways to citizenship."
It's an unmitigated catastrophe, and it's Joe Biden's fault, pure and simple.
**And Judicial Watch is "the only game in town" when it comes to challenging the Biden administration and the Left over illegal immigration!**
**[But we face an illegal immigration crisis so severe that we need your special support at this critical time.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE) **
** | [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**

The social, medical, law enforcement and educational services to illegal aliens from every level of government are costing us **_hundreds of billions of dollar_ s...literally costing you and me _hundreds if not thousands of dollars a year in additional taxes a year_.** And that's without considering national security, quality-of-life and the very serious matter of voter registration irregularities and potential _voter fraud that the Biden administration is willing to overlook_.

Here's what else we know:

**" Open borders" groups and their media allies are doing all they can to make it easier for ineligible voters like illegal aliens to vote in this November's elections.**

And, quite frankly, they seem to be getting away with it!

_That 's why we need your help to step up our legal efforts to counter Biden's radical immigration agenda, enforce our laws against illegal immigration, and defend voter ID laws in the courts of law and public opinion_.

** [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**

Our research suggests that rapid increases in costs associated with the impact of illegal immigration have __already__ affected residents in __many regions__ of the country. We also uncovered information and data suggesting fraudulent voter registrations and illegal voting by illegal aliens. And many questions hang in the balance...

* Will the Biden Justice Department continue to attack states with voter ID and other commonsense ballot integrity measures? (_They sued**Georgia** last June and __**Texas** last November._)

* How much higher will taxpayer-funded costs for school, medical, court, police and other services associated with illegal immigration continue to increase in many areas of the country?

* Are experts correct in predicting that direct and indirect federal, state and local taxpayer-funded costs associated with illegal immigration will continue to rise at double-digit rates unless there is more immigration law enforcement?

**Sadly, most lawmakers do not equate illegal immigration with run-away state and local taxes and reduced government services -- _especially its terrible burden on our schools_.**

Many school budgets are requiring more tax dollars for new school construction, teacher and administrator salaries, special language classes, etc. And while exploding school budgets cannot be attributed to a single source, the impact of large-scale illegal immigration and so-called "dreamer" demands cannot be ignored. Rising school costs' impact on property taxes is just one example of skyrocketing local and state government costs.

We're also working to make clear _the threat our electoral system faces when the radical Hispanic lobby and other groups ...many bankrolled by radical billionaire George Soros and aided and abetted by the hard-left Biden administration to help illegal aliens obtain legal status and vote in __our elections_ ...** _as corrupt an assault on the integrity of our system of representative democracy as ever attempted_.**

For these reasons and more **Judicial Watch** is deeply involved in courtroom actions across America fighting for federal and state immigration law enforcement.

** [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**

And We're fighting illegal immigration's impact on _honest elections_ because "dirty" or _inaccurate voter rolls make it easier for illegal aliens and other ineligible voters to vote_. That's why we're (successfully) suing states in federal court to compel them to follow federal law and clean their voter registration rolls.

_Our aim is to make the costs to taxpayers, the threats to our electoral system, the risks of_ _criminal violence and the burdens to our entire system of government created by illegal immigration, issues that cannot be ignored, deflected or dismissed by the open-borders lobby and the Biden administration_.

And if we can help states protect voter ID laws over the challenges by the radical Hispanic lobby and the organized Left, then we will provide important help in maintaining the integrity of our elections and reasserting the fundamental principle that **_only qualified American citizens have the _****_right to vote and collect benefits paid for by taxpayers_!**

[I urge you to make a tax-deductible contribution to **Judicial Watch** to help support this important work.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

** [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27942&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**

Your participation and additional support are essential.

And please remember this:

**Judicial Watch** doesn't just complain about illegal immigration...thanks to your your past support we have sued state and local officials who violate immigration laws by establishing "sanctuary" policies that protect illegal aliens; we are fighting and winning in the courts to protect the integrity of our elections; and we are forcing the federal government to reveal documents about bureaucratic efforts to grant amnesty to illegal aliens through unlawful backdoor methods.

So please give what you can.

Your additional contribution will be extremely helpful as we challenge the Biden administration's radical immigration policies and fight to enforce our laws against illegal immigration.

There are forces in both political parties...with allies buried deep in the federal bureaucracy...who want to keep illegal aliens flooding into our nation. They are powerful and well-funded, and they have an important ally in the White House.

But **Judicial Watch 's** pursuit of justice and accountability and our defense of the rule of law are relentless. _Our investigations and legal work in the courts pay off and are delivering real results_. [That’s why I am hoping you will make a tax-deductible contribution to **Judicial Watch**.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27942&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

** [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60176&L=27942&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**

Thank you as always for your generous support of our work!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

| | Peter, Donald Trump just can't stand not being the center of attention. Lately, he's been making the rounds, inserting himself into Republican primaries by promoting his chosen extremist candidates, desperately trying to remain relevant. It's a reminder of just how dangerous Trump remains to our democracy. Recently, Trump even bragged that a candidate he endorsed will "rule with an iron fist." You know who else Donald Trump praised for ruling with an "iron fist?" _Chinese President Xi Jinping._ There's a certain common thread to leaders that Donald Trump admires. Xi Xinping, Vladimir Putin, Kim Jong Un, Viktor Orban – Trump praises them all. Explicitly. Team,

Ohio is facing a crisis, one that has been growing for years – and now, with Mike DeWine’s abortion ban in effect, it’s getting worse: As I travel around the state, I keep hearing over and over again that folks aren’t sure they’ll stay in Ohio.

Corporations have been abandoning Ohio’s workers for years by taking jobs out of state. Now, even more companies are considering moving out of red states to ensure that their employees will be able to access needed medical care.

And It’s not just corporations leaving. One third generation Ohioan studying to become a doctor told _Columbus Business First_ , “I don’t see a place for myself in Ohio.” Three generations of Ohio roots, torn up by Mike DeWine’s anti-abortion agenda.

# **Letter: Student loan forgiveness just a political stunt**
#
## _Candidate for Congress takes issue with Biden administration_
**Dear Editor: ** President Joe Biden’s announcement on student debt is political public relations in the run-up to the midterms. It’s not clear that a president has the authority to unilaterally cancel student debt, as House Speaker Nancy Pelosi herself stated this past summer. [](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=5f08bb6149&e=0a4d873a55) The Biden administration is attempting to use the 2003 Heroes Act, which was intended to give relief to active-duty military during war times, not wipe out student debt for broad swaths of the U.S.

The Penn Wharton Budget Model estimates a price tag of well over $500 billion for this, potentially going as high as $1 trillion. _**My opponent Madeleine Dean wants even more student debt forgiveness, $50,000 for all borrowers**_. And let’s be clear: this is transference, not forgiveness. These student loans will be paid back in the form of taxes, paid by farmers, plumbers, and factory workers whether they attended college or not. This would further exacerbate our already record inflation and put government in a position to pick winners and losers. Worst of all, it does nothing to address the costs of going to college, as universities will feel no impact from this, tuition fees having already been paid when the borrowing originated. If we want to help with the skyrocketing costs of higher education, why don’t we encourage more participation in trade schools and vo-techs, tie federal funding to colleges to tuition costs, or develop and expand programs that forgive portions of debt in return for public service?
**Christian Nascimento**
Audubon _Editor’s note: Nascimento is the Republican nominee for House of Representatives in the 4th Congressional District, which includes parts of Berks and Montgomery counties._ **Thank you for your hard work.[_Thank you for your support_](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=203c23c100&e=0a4d873a55). Thank you for your contribution to my campaign.**
**Now let's win this race! ** Christian Nascimento [](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=e36dc3aa05&e=0a4d873a55)

This is huge –
With so much on the line this election, 1,017 votes is too close for comfort.
**But, folks, this victory was only possible thanks to the 1,017 votes that secured this seat in 2016.**
That's right. I won this seat by less than half of a percentage point – one of the closest Senate races in history.
And it's not just the Inflation Reduction Act. Thanks to those 1,017 votes, Senate Democrats saved the Affordable Care Act in 2017, passed the American Rescue Plan in 2021, and confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court in 2022.
**That's the difference 1,017 votes make.**
But because the GOP only needs to flip one seat to take the Senate, that 1,017 vote margin is also the reason Republicans see New Hampshire as one of their best chances at taking back the majority.
And they're not wrong. Political experts are calling New Hampshire one of the most likely seats to flip, and public polling has me down by two points to an extreme GOP opponent.
With so much on the line this election – including our Senate majority – I need your help. That's why I'm calling on you today.

| | I want to start by saying thank you. While the outcome on Tuesday was not what we fought for, this campaign has never been about an election cycle.
* It’s about the voices of the hundreds of thousands of voters who have never been heard at the polls and do not believe our democracy is working for them.
* It’s about the countless residents in our communities who, for too long, have no relationship with or connection to the state’s Chief Democracy Office ... or how it could improve their families’ lives.
* It’s about the small businesses that have spent years in a one way transactional relationship with a chief corporations office that has never considered how it could help level the economic playing field by simply focusing on support for small businesses.

So, we continue to have more work to do to ensure our democracy is working for all of us. I have no doubt that if we commit to leaning in, believing in what’s possible, we will deliver for Massachusetts, and in the process become a beacon for the rest of the nation! The seeds have been planted. If you believed in our vision for a stronger, more vibrant and expansive democracy you can’t stop now. Continue to share what you’ve learned and stand tall on the democracy issues that matter most in these times...
* Voter participation and economic opportunity.
* Transparency in government.
* Pushing back on the existential threats to our democracy, and to our freedoms, including reproductive freedom.

Remember, together we showed what’s possible with proactive leadership in this office, don’t let the spark wither...keep moving forward. In closing, I want to thank the delegates of the 2022 Massachusetts Democratic Convention for endorsing me in June and lighting a fire under this campaign. You let us know that our vision for this office is what we should aspire toward as Massachusetts democrats. I also want to thank my friends in labor representing more than a hundred thousand workers, and the incredible grassroots organizations that supported us – not only here in Massachusetts, but across the country. And, I want to thank all the elected officials at the federal, state and municipal levels who showed the courage to come out publicly for our campaign. clean_body: | | | = | | I want to start by saying thank you. While the outcome on Tuesday was not what we fought for, this campaign has never been about an election cycle. It’s about the voices of the hundreds of thousands of voters who have never been heard at the polls and do not believe our democracy is working for them. It’s about the countless residents in our communities who, for too long, have no relationship with or connection to the state’s Chief Democracy Office ... or how it could improve their families’ lives. It’s about the small businesses that have spent years in a one way transactional relationship with a chief corporations office that has never considered how it could help level the economic playing field by simply focusing on support for small businesses. So, we continue to have more work to do to ensure our democracy is working for all of us. I have no doubt that if we commit to leaning in, believing in what’s possible, we will deliver for Massachusetts, and in the process become a beacon for the rest of the nation! The seeds have been planted. If you believed in our vision for a stronger, more vibrant and expansive democracy you can’t stop now. Continue to share what you’ve learned and stand tall on the democracy issues that matter most in these times... Voter participation and economic opportunity. Transparency in government. Pushing back on the existential threats to our democracy, and to our freedoms, including reproductive freedom. Remember, together we showed what’s possible with proactive leadership in this office, don’t let the spark wither...keep moving forward. In closing, I want to thank the delegates of the 2022 Massachusetts Democratic Convention for endorsing me in June and lighting a fire under this campaign. You let us know that our vision for this office is what we should aspire toward as Massachusetts democrats. | Yesterday, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, unveiled his campaign's first ad in the general election.
"I'm excited to share a glimpse of my vision for Colorado with my future constituents," stated Aadland. "Though I never intended to run for office, our children's future is in jeopardy if we do not bring reasonable, wise leadership to DC and heal the divisiveness in our society. My desire is to make CD7 safer and more affordable--which is exactly what I will strive to do as this district's next Congressman."

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons, or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professionals, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything!

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas and becoming energy independent. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

Peter,

While the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) has brought

Victory Fund this year to support their corporate candidates, Justice

progressive candidates.

Peter. We always operate on a
tight budget, using everything we can to re-elect the Squad, help new
leaders like Summer Lee and Greg Casar defeat the establishment, and
advocate for progressive change. But money is especially tight right now,
and our fundraising over the next few months will determine how much we
can invest in November and recruiting the next Summer Lee, AOC, or Cori
Bush to run in 2024.

you step up in a big way and make your first contribution to Justice

this one — we’re relying on you to help us make our next moves.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113966?refcode=em20220908-25051&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=25051%2E1203867%2EQxziSg ]Contribute

Our online fundraising has gone down almost every month this year. We’re
13.7% behind where we were at this point last year in our ActBlue. Up
against the corporate-funded Democratic Party, this kind of fundraising
won’t cut it.

The amount of grassroots dollars we can bring in directly impacts how many
races we can invest in. Your contributions — whether it’s $5, $27 or $50 —
will help us go bigger for 2024. Recruiting and running candidates is an
18-month process, at least. That means we’re planning for 2024 right now.
All while we still have elections to win in November.

And the only checks we’ll see from Nancy Pelosi are donations to our
opponents.

We’ve got a lot of work to do, Peter —
and we can only do it with your help.

Justice Democrats

subject: Help give us a much needed boost, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Just hours from the end of our 24 hour deadline.
#
Peter,
I wanted to email one last time before our 24 hour fundraising deadline was over, and [**ask you to chip in $3 right now to help us get our fundraising back on track.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17139?refcode=em20220908-1598&t=1&akid=1598%2E420207%2ESKjODG)
After folks stepped up yesterday, we’re just $2,751 short of our goal with a few hours left to hit it. If _just 102 folks_ reading this email donated $27 to my campaign, I’d get the fundraising boost I need to help protect our Democratic majorities, elect progressives who support Medicare for All, and advocate for the transformative change we need in this country.
Simply put, our fundraising has lagged behind where it needs to be these last few months. And catching up right now means I’ll have the support I need to take on the extremist GOP and build on our wins over the last 2 years.
[**My 24 hour fundraising deadline is almost up — can you donate $3 to help us reach our $7,500 goal?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17139?refcode=em20220908-1598&t=2&akid=1598%2E420207%2ESKjODG) **_Our fundraising must be strong heading into these critical weeks before the midterms._**
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17139?refcode=em20220908-1598&t=21&akid=1598%2E420207%2ESKjODG)**
Each fundraising goal that we set is important for achieving our collective goals. I need your support to campaign in full force for Democrats facing GOP extremists in swing districts and progressives running to expand support for Medicare for All in Congress.
Your small-dollar donations go a long way to fight back against the corporate lobbyists from Wall Street, Big Oil, and health insurance companies. With your support, I can continue the fight to protect our environment, codify our rights, and expand our social safety net.
The work of holding our majority and building on our progressive victories over the past two years is so, so important — and I really need to see a boost in my fundraising right now in order to do everything possible to protect our democracy and build a better future for all of us.
[**Donate right now to help me hit my 24 hour, $7,500 fundraising goal. There’s only a few hours left and $2,751 left to raise. I’m counting on you, Peter.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17139?refcode=em20220908-1598&t=22&akid=1598%2E420207%2ESKjODG)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17139?refcode=em20220908-1598&t=23&akid=1598%2E420207%2ESKjODG)**
Thank you for being with me in this tough work in a difficult midterm election year.
In solidarity,
Pramila

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: TODAY: KNOW YOUR POWER: SHOW YOUR POWER. Speaker Pelosi’s Weekly Grassroots Volunteer Update, with Congresswoman-Elect Mary Peltola from Alaska, Thursday, September 8th at 3:30 PM PT / 6:30 PM ET.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

Today, we kick off our 2-month countdown to victory on November 8th with a very special guest, Congresswoman-Elect Mary Peltola of Alaska, at our weekly Grassroots Volunteer update: TODAY — Thursday, September 8th, at 3:30 PM PT / 6:30 PM ET.

Congresswoman-Elect Peltola will represent the state of Alaska in the House. The first Democratic U.S. Representative from Alaska in more than fifty years, she is also the first Native Alaskan to be elected to Congress in U.S. History.

Congresswoman-Elect Peltola ran and won on an “adamantly Pro-Jobs, Pro-Fish, Pro-Family and Pro-Choice” platform that reflects the needs and values of Alaska. Informed by her record of engaged leadership and of working diligently to meet the needs of her neighbor-constituents dating back to her first election to the Alaska State House at the age of 24, Congresswoman-Elect Peltola is set to hit the ground running in the House on behalf of ALL Alaskans.

We look forward to a discussion on the Congresswoman-Elect’s story and priorities For The People of Alaska as she joins the Congress in the coming days! House Democrats are honored and excited to welcome this proven champion for freedom and Democracy to join us in this fight.

Again, please note that we are convening at a *Special Earlier Time* TODAY – 3:30 PM PT / 6:30 PM ET. RSVP here:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_EltQHW9IR3OrHpPG-7VzAg

Democrats – Know Your Power: Show Your Power. At the polls!Thank you, our VIPs – our amazing Volunteers in Politics, for your tremendous support of our House Democrats! Because of you, we are Ready For Victory!

NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

clean_body: We’re just 61 days from the midterm elections and there’s a lot at stake. | | Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , in red state after red state there’s a race to pass the most restrictive abortion laws imaginable -- even outlawing abortion in the cases of rape and incest. But these MAGA Republicans won’t stop there: They want a national ban. We can’t afford to let MAGA Republicans win. So, I have to ask: Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today to invest in the organizing programs, voter mobilization, and more it will take to elect Democrats up and down the ballot on November 8? If MAGA Republicans win control of Congress, it won’t matter where you live in America. Women won’t have a right to choose anywhere. Then they’re coming after contraception and marriage equality -- the whole right to privacy. We can’t let that happen. And I don’t believe we will. Our conception of community and of our nation is being threatened.

**That is why it is up to people of faith to lead our country back to the path of righteousness.**

Christians must restore our notion of character to our country and our world. The proclamation of faith is paramount.

We Christians need to communicate our belief that everyone is endowed with dignity that must be respected because we all bear the mark of the Creator.

This principle is the means to bring our divided country together without hatred or bitterness.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61228091:Jna7bvVtN:m:1:3253819041:67E3324A42F47EBF4934B0FCFFB8B447:r)
---

It is with this understanding and respect for our past that we must once again openly profess our faith and our devotion to our families, and proclaim unapologetically the words, **" I am a Christian and I am an American."**

**If you think faith will put America back on track,__[please sign my petition today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61228091:Jna7bvVtN:m:1:3253819041:67E3324A42F47EBF4934B0FCFFB8B447:r "please sign my petition today.")__ **

---

I do not doubt that faith is the key to delivering America to salvation and freeing us from the amoral disposition our nation now finds itself in.

Thank you for all you do to make our country a better place.

God Bless,

body:

| Peter-
Here are two data points I want you to think about as we head into September:
MARCH 2022
Republicans \- 46 Democrats \- 41
SEPTEMBER 2022
Democrats \- 47 Republicans \- 44
Those are polls - called generic congressional ballot tests - which ask a simple question to voters: which party would you rather see in control of Congress, Republicans or Democrats?
In March, just six months ago, Republicans held a five point advantage in the generic congressional ballot over Democrats. But today, *Democrats* hold a three point advantage in the generic congressional ballot over Republicans. That is an eight point swing in favor of the Democrat Party for control of Congress in November.
Think about the environment in which Democrats achieved this eight point swing in their favor:

* Inflation is the highest it's been in decades. The typical family is paying $450 more per month to buy the same basic goods and services than they did a year ago.

* The historic border crisis continues to surge, with more than 4 MILLION illegal immigrants crossing our borders since Biden took office. And now, Mexican drug cartels are taking advantage of Biden's open border policies to flood deadly fentanyl into our communities.

* Violent crime is rampant across America's cities under liberal bail-reform policies that put repeat murderers and violent offenders back on our streets.

---
| In the midst of all of this, one would expect Republicans, not Democrats, to widen their lead when Americans are asked which party they would rather see in control of Congress. But, instead, the opposite has happened.
The obvious question is: why?
I think the answer is as obvious as the question itself: Americans *know* things are bad under Biden and the Democrats. They don't want or need to be constantly reminded about the trouble they can see and feel and read for themselves. What they want and need are actual solutions, actual policy objectives from Republicans that articulate how Republican governance and conservative principles offer a better path forward for the country and their families.
That's exactly what I'm trying to do. When I launch messaging campaigns on these issues, I explain why having a Republican-controlled Congress will help get our country back on track. I highlight how Republicans will be a check on the rampant spending from the Biden administration, that we will block any attempts to raise taxes, redistribute wealth, or use taxpayer dollars as bribes for votes. I outline an agenda on border security, where we will put commonsense border security bills on the floor of the House of Representatives and dare President Biden to veto them - legislation to give our Border Patrol more resources to secure our border... to fix the loopholes in our asylum process that encourage illegal immigration... to reimplement policies that prioritize deporting illegal immigrants instead of releasing them into our country. And I prioritize giving more funding to our local police officers and less leeway for liberal prosecutors and judges to turn a blind eye to violent crime.
Americans also want to be inspired by the Republican Party... they don't want to hear the same doom and gloom rhetoric that they deal with enough as their reality under full-Democrat control of Washington. They want to know the conservative movement is a place to point their children as a party of inspiration and hope and encouragement. That's why I hold my [Youth Summit every single year in Texas](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Baqjkz34BrHj2Wo_0Pis31OJ1ctezK-xo3XP7rdqZ4uy4g6lH2nvosRsE3HcWuCSboSb_VmdfWtCnXuLgt0fCsCSaKvFaDvlJ7Lit6em_5YLKHTU09rHpkHqge5sxkvat4YK4DkCE72obRYVLUJ2ou1GLXGTUC39nPed3SDFT_thEv9mkuoNXSJRjk1v11PQx8llc_237rFW86P5yFsUhLMedeWsoGsNBCIxj9BZeHEFPB2PHLMI0A==&c=fJGTVgO_01Pn3xz7lPm3JEMbMRFY9zHR8-v84Cg4UbsAqVUbEfFXmA==&ch=Yn4mmBI-MUxfilVYLsDKQUySgcRQV6aMFapaNErvtUWPAjyH8ZIY_A==), drawing thousands of young people from across the country to hear from an all-star lineup of speakers. This event is not replete with the same red-meat, over-the-top rhetoric you hear at traditional political conferences... and it's for anyone on the political spectrum whether they are already a diehard conservative or simply open and curious to the ideas of conservatism. Children and their parents walk away from this summit every year feeling uplifted and inspired, not angry and pessimistic.
And Americans want candidates on the Republican ticket who focus on the real issues they are facing and approach them with a sense of optimism instead of outrage. They want an alternative to vote for, someone who is not focused on personality or party politics but rather the everyday, real problems families are discussing every night at their dinner tables. That's why I spend my time and resources traveling across the country campaigning for common sense conservatives who can win in swing districts in swing states like Colorado and Michigan and Texas - people who will go to Congress and legislate instead of bloviate.
All of these efforts take money, a lot of it. And while other politicians might stash their donations away in some campaign "war chest," I immediately use the donations I gratefully receive to grow our conservative movement, offer an alternative vision to voters, and ensure Republicans are in the strongest possible position to win up and down the ballot in November. Why do I do this? Because if you're committed enough to send your hard-earned money to me, I feel an obligation to be just as committed to putting your money to a good, tangible cause.
The "red wave" we all hear about isn't something that's just going to magically happen; it's something we're going to have to earn. I am committed to earning it and I know you are too. If you are able to, and agree with this mission I laid out, I ask that you donate to my campaign at the link below. Any amount helps.
We're going to win in November with committed patriots like you.
Thank you sincerely for your support and generous donation. God bless you and God bless America.
---

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=35ef351be9ed418b9e70b85276990080&_e=lXSoOvBtgWSEANpVJOP3Wh5m2HTZRsZQtbjia2vpXpwrh_6QxYKVMS51Xz2-_ICQRMdl7VAHHvTGnUeyVkCKvAU1ELPjXGkjeaG0_kh_OA3djRbdaxeWEz4bcUiA4uxgYb1C6fIR2-7LTMTd9V_SQpRRhT8S49huuGhgCYU5PnEMXMbC1EJxPWr1nmDoHzOvEtZLsEGewf1zRgY8sXZCyYpMYaAIeP9eAy6lHR22NMH9j5rDQ6Fh3SKq0Kb3avIaO3laObNaMDSzNALZK9dt5n1GFAAITn_BPVaUvokGyomDt2Q_yw60KqahoEKvWPxwIfeRzlyzWQ3bOCkQPCNIsL2hCiioeCqoGIVUFi33e5mQa_GXlfN9rao-WkBiLkMXzCR18t-YZhnQg7lDE_CuNA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=35ef351be9ed418b9e70b85276990080&_e=lXSoOvBtgWSEANpVJOP3Wh5m2HTZRsZQtbjia2vpXpwrh_6QxYKVMS51Xz2-_ICQRMdl7VAHHvTGnUeyVkCKvAU1ELPjXGkjeaG0_kh_OA3djRbdaxeWEz4bcUiA4uxgYb1C6fIR2-7LTMTd9V_SQpRRhT8S49huuGhgCYU5PnEMXMbC1EJxPWr1nmDoHzOvEtZLsEGewf1zRgY8sXZCyYpMYaAIeP9eAy6lHR22NMEP2r33n7OtiNPMH8znZCA1fkOLleyUMc_Sj6nh39Ec3TNvmXsoG9gwusb6ZkpcbW9cyvJjX04cNJBp4bB1h_ungC6dhmDDI8__7qmOuDePG5Z67LjVs3to7SV89CnN-0T29Pf9LH6z9NHyIIBHRuw5EtmEFPE5Z_MRafB3umhRFw%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=35ef351be9ed418b9e70b85276990080&_e=lXSoOvBtgWSEANpVJOP3Wh5m2HTZRsZQtbjia2vpXpwrh_6QxYKVMS51Xz2-_ICQRMdl7VAHHvTGnUeyVkCKvAU1ELPjXGkjeaG0_kh_OA3djRbdaxeWEz4bcUiA4uxgYb1C6fIR2-7LTMTd9V_SQpRRhT8S49huuGhgCYU5PnEMXMbC1EJxPWr1nmDoHzOvEtZLsEGewf1zRgY8sXZCyYpMYaAIeP9eAy6lHR22NMH_aqtVegTWZgS9BXVyVJek8cF9fF6ISEQz45RBf6X-3FUtCkH8THr86ol4jvqWs8amXDHeQWtMzymsh4eVppgZ_G8hON8Nrt-nie2XlGsDWMEi5nREY_B2f5JgpEpWSgg-PeGwTfcXjljjTzAdMJZG-e3pKrY_z2ynjiL4I61Hdw%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

| [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=01b791a923cf4b11811a9c1ddb277ef2&_e=97u-oxPONQ2PA8N9LTaS8hwU-bVXLiNj8pk7Pa4o7yq-Bknv2zVoe0DLkeU436EXgYEJ2K42Z0hC10l-b0ybf-Xvd4OFwxihYvAENRGUVvm0He-2CtwseVW9akUDzYZg2trjOVXPUderEkKBpT-TDq16vsGFjaLEOwEqzBlCSf_D9j0kkGPNkf7oWZT-mZTMzyj5dLFuV-WNnVORAOVyoMW5XH60bfx_KsklJkq4ApAY20MkDB4gnW4Zf247vi2DMovHE6fMf6UGMcvvpp_6y-wihlZ5KVqpdJ76Elj9c1KTaE1POVRsUhCzMQTaxT_N)

Fellow Conservative,

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden’s dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I’m asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and midnight tomorrow?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=01b791a923cf4b11811a9c1ddb277ef2&_e=97u-oxPONQ2PA8N9LTaS8hwU-bVXLiNj8pk7Pa4o7yq-Bknv2zVoe0DLkeU436EXgYEJ2K42Z0hC10l-b0ybf-Xvd4OFwxihYvAENRGUVvm0He-2CtwseVW9akUDzYZg2trjOVXPUderEkKBpT-TDrgJ87sXvxt8gJZV7iQYaJN-gYrBUsr9go6QQ7ozKGTMNO3k2lGLoTVIr9OsqoenW8TyQlXFqRfTd0k_N6vGGrcChdGymJmpQfSG-_qvOTYsUfwO2MtxSE9303R9uvVrhHhzWqRWHsQNBejkzkrog-cE-QhdrWXBKjTbKJVtF1zq)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE MIDNIGHT TOMORROW ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=01b791a923cf4b11811a9c1ddb277ef2&_e=97u-oxPONQ2PA8N9LTaS8hwU-bVXLiNj8pk7Pa4o7yq-Bknv2zVoe0DLkeU436EXgYEJ2K42Z0hC10l-b0ybf-Xvd4OFwxihYvAENRGUVvm0He-2CtwseVW9akUDzYZg2trjOVXPUderEkKBpT-TDgGCBEQEM1RDs0ZgHmZh1_7XdHFFtzzhm4DWtiBvMBGGnaf9Pzw1O_sLqdXIi9Q_SMF_HxJzuMN_xyFV4BtUSpK76lDQL-V9tOhp8EDFnSeakznmoMWH6jWsFGjL7LtDsn7qrwOBXUxiqLqPiusMuYk3XqSH8b_j2f1FaU2ihtk-)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it’s just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It’s about more freedom vs. more government control. **It’s about whether we serve the government ... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

name: Alex Padilla
subject: I’m writing to ask you to support my bill to protect workers exposed to dangerous heat conditions in the workplace.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
As California and the rest of the country face punishing heat waves, rising temperatures are increasingly dangerous for workers.
#

Hi team,
I’m writing to ask you to support my bill to protect workers exposed to dangerous heat conditions in the workplace.
It’s called the _Asunción Valdivia Heat Illness and Fatality Prevention Act_ and I’ll tell you more about it and why it’s so important in just a minute, but if you’re already on board, it would mean a lot if you could add your name here to show your support:
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Heat**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/heat-standards-em-Sep22/?source=em220908-1-30&refcode2=978.159979.Hh2CWy&akid=978%2E159979%2EHh2CWy)
Here is the deal:
As California and the rest of the country face punishing heat waves, rising temperatures are increasingly dangerous for workers. **But right now, there is _no_ federal standard to ensure the health and safety of workers exposed to dangerous heat conditions.**
That’s wrong. Our farmworkers, postal workers, construction workers, and ALL who work in these conditions deserve protection.
That’s why my bill would direct the Occupational Safety and Health Administration to establish a standard to protect workers from hazardous heat, including:
🚰 access to water,
🧊 paid breaks in cool spaces,
🚑 emergency response, and
⏲️ limitations on the amount of time exposed to heat.
The climate crisis has accelerated the dangers of extreme heat, especially in California where we’re also suffering from record rough and dangerous wildfires. So we can’t afford to wait:
[**Please, add your name to mine to say you support a federal standard to protect workers from increasingly hot and dangerous conditions.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/heat-standards-em-Sep22/?source=em220908-1-30&refcode2=978.159979.Hh2CWy&akid=978%2E159979%2EHh2CWy)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/heat-standards-em-Sep22/?source=em220908-1-30&refcode2=978.159979.Hh2CWy&akid=978%2E159979%2EHh2CWy)**
Thank you,
Alex Padilla

Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=978%2E159979%2EHh2CWy)

name: Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6f0baf17e1d64c65a504fac7c80b55dd&_e=wZwT_TBLj0M66Q-KBGM7MKv3Rsv6As4GdoEfN0CoUSYOtraUPIz5n0BJN1-6KEPWo63y7BL7BT5HLRiJskda7kz0eFznDmdh7BwB4DYqtmB1vT_zFwOoifjgZ1-7sAfQ1fmyVgg37AC2HsEkdMkzNDRARcqoONp3gwt87TGq-JP5P6WFpqYD9YRY8P2ntsuIw-qfrv2Yf3TE6b5DcplSfaNOdsDIGOzcazmExHtUG8ApEJO3tfhI4AyuZ9CcUMqERD68IIPR_6C2m8_x7FgzIXSEyskvRCKNhCpPHYgPOa5c0b_zmad6ZfX0ipP6PQhtyCZsJE0eCa54Gzg2oG_LV0lAL7a2PRBMUYKkRWmm0hisdQhoAYFc9fVVUq_t03ORaLqyimuiuyd-p-wGyU1c-w%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6f0baf17e1d64c65a504fac7c80b55dd&_e=wZwT_TBLj0M66Q-KBGM7MKv3Rsv6As4GdoEfN0CoUSYOtraUPIz5n0BJN1-6KEPWo63y7BL7BT5HLRiJskda7kz0eFznDmdh7BwB4DYqtmB1vT_zFwOoifjgZ1-7sAfQ1fmyVgg37AC2HsEkdMkzNDRARcqoONp3gwt87TGq-JP5P6WFpqYD9YRY8P2ntsuIw-qfrv2Yf3TE6b5DcplSfaNOdsDIGOzcazmExHtUG8BjaKlvcAGNRbBZrPXLL4vnl1mnlDxJzJpSWtVgDos56hdrtRwvFgy5Z21vpoJkygmJcpBkk_3A_FSXg4z0abOyju2Z-L2rPGJli5O8hOpNNd0odPme0w6OxqWi0y82Hu2xO6W1YYJNinE_K9t8VrS8r3qzZRrqyPwG92ynNfiIBA%3D%3D)**
For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College.
**And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.**
So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.
**You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6f0baf17e1d64c65a504fac7c80b55dd&_e=wZwT_TBLj0M66Q-KBGM7MKv3Rsv6As4GdoEfN0CoUSYOtraUPIz5n0BJN1-6KEPWo63y7BL7BT5HLRiJskda7kz0eFznDmdh7BwB4DYqtmB1vT_zFwOoifjgZ1-7sAfQ1fmyVgg37AC2HsEkdMkzNDRARcqoONp3gwt87TGq-JP5P6WFpqYD9YRY8P2ntsuIw-qfrv2Yf3TE6b5DcplSfaNOdsDIGOzcazmExHtUG8CMqnCZLlk8vemDNXJMCpAiizd--2mogNmWW4v2qqC4uyERhJiXrtSEaWh5wyJebDS9Ik21nZUWbJv-fAZThSvWFWRMSAY7PRpjMGTCVnOWTtzvOOTm0MMI784CCgfrCz9x5NER_jWyJa6IIt08nt4s8xUnhyzrBN2nvJRBO9X2Ww%3D%3D)**
And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.
Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.
Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dear Friend,
This week, a judge informed state lawmakers that the Tennessee Department of Children’s Services is near collapse. The staffing shortage that has led to this issue follows a pattern seen across the state, whether it’s with public school teachers or other government employees — workers are not feeling valued.
The DCS is vital to ensuring that children in this state have the necessary resources to become productive members of society. It should be lawmakers’ absolute priority to ensure that it has the funding it needs to do its job, and that means making jobs easier for its employees and making clear that they are valued.
We need a governor who will assume leadership in this crisis and direct lawmakers to fully fund and reform the DCS. With our current governor, leadership is absent not only in this issue but across the board. I promise that when I am in office, we will work on the issues that are important to Tennesseans. But I’ll need your help to get there.

Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends,

When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.

Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.

Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.

Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.

But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.

In combat, I had my wingmen.

With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.

And in these campaigns, I have you.

Fellow Concerned American,

I know I don't have to tell you our borders are in shambles.

But I do have to tell you just how bad it's gotten.

Crime and chaos are taking over our country as we've never seen - have you seen the latest news reports?

Now, I don't know where you live.

One thing is for sure: we do not want any more of our cities to end up like Los Angeles or New York.

But I'm telling you about what's happening in America's worst sanctuary cities, because what started in Los Angeles and New York won't stay there.

The Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is fighting back against dangerous sanctuary city policies.

In fact, we've even published a document exposing the worst sanctuary cities in America!

But we need your help to stay in the fight.

[**So please consider making a tax-deductible donation of $22 or more to IRLI today, and while you 're at it, take a look at our exclusive new report, the Top 10 Worst Sanctuary Cities in America. **](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2841dea2093f46eebb2d5fef5cdcf1f9&_e=ApdX54T_dEwsI_0QFz5MI4Zkk4P-hwGZDgv-8oUVWH24WXGpW6TwhZXMBW0MsqyKMXmT6XomKPvNLFR5oWUzg-RoS668i690DgTclguaFuCLmzD2MhXrx2tVfmH2vbdaTqwsPSLc3Awh6cJtKtgisjgHhTLM1UGYFzhCxuXww-jt4qwWTEhSUaat9JOX-SG1y_2wjOIsfowDQDEkfIQiGo978dtb7e5oJmqMwxpl-NYQtGiZTmbVRQOFszFzVaTbVxM09nN2ryb9IzoCUYKMfM66r12Jcj7iLzwY307zyyVtifwTVInZPke9lu-rtLnv7CBjaAyf6Gh4lYuXXiVq4XiUP8rHqXuGVQQ5lyfxzn5Cf9pb-b_-EP_Ux5cO3PH39LBZXrq5o75Q-H2ayzUD7A%3D%3D)

**Anti-border politicians are doing everything in their power to bring this lawlessness to YOUR backyard.**

Oregon has a hotline set up for citizens to report violations of the state's sanctuary law.

You read that right.

It's not a hotline to report illegal aliens, but a hotline to report people for not doing enough to protect illegal aliens!

The city of Seattle demanded a $100 million COVID relief fund for illegal aliens from Washington state.

San Francisco's DA even created a special unit with the sole purpose of helping illegal aliens avoid deportation.

And that's just the tip of the iceberg.

**Now, I know if you 're the patriot I think you are, this all sounds crazy to you.**

It sounds like something that could never happen in America.

But that just isn't true.

My name is Dale Wilcox, and I've been with the Immigration Reform Law Institute for eight years now because I believe that our nation must be able to defend its borders and uphold the rule of law.

Our team has seen the effects of anti-border policies up close and personal - and that's why we work so hard to make sure the rest of America doesn't have to.

In every single sanctuary city and county across the country, Americans are in more danger.

It's no coincidence.

After all, when you reward criminals, lawlessness is sure to follow.

But I'm writing to you today because there's something you can do.

[**You can give a generous, tax-deductible gift of $22 or more to IRLI and give our attorneys the ammunition we need to take on the America Last legislators rolling out the red carpet for illegal aliens.**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2841dea2093f46eebb2d5fef5cdcf1f9&_e=ApdX54T_dEwsI_0QFz5MI4Zkk4P-hwGZDgv-8oUVWH24WXGpW6TwhZXMBW0MsqyKMXmT6XomKPvNLFR5oWUzg-RoS668i690DgTclguaFuCLmzD2MhXrx2tVfmH2vbdaTqwsPSLc3Awh6cJtKtgisjgHhTLM1UGYFzhCxuXww-jt4qwWTEhSUaat9JOX-SG1y_2wjOIsfowDQDEkfIQiGo978dtb7e5oJmqMwxpl-NYQtGiZTmbVRQOFszFzVaTbNjMXj4C9h6DaId1BYsYBJ8M4J5rjgNSqitaXr7_Ar6ZvmPgaHT2Hv4nqfaY_mj-vg5ONlLP9slXo00Ur9SkJBLWMfJqTf9RVQYclGfvm4ixUiXsA6afwU-9YP7cyUIIsyTHLgAqUQ5XSt_3Yf-OWnw%3D%3D)

To put it simply, the courts are our best bet.

We must be prepared to take on the legal battles that will shape our nation, and we can't do that without your help.

If you don't want the same reckless policies that overtook LA and New York introduced in your own community, I hope we can count on your urgent support.

Sincerely,

But I do have to tell you just how bad it's gotten. Crime and chaos are taking over our country as we've never seen - have you seen the latest news reports? Now, I don't know where you live. One thing is for sure: we do not want any more of our cities to end up like Los Angeles or New York. But I'm telling you about what's happening in America's worst sanctuary cities, because what started in Los Angeles and New York won't stay there. The Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) is fighting back against dangerous sanctuary city policies. In fact, we've even published a document exposing the worst sanctuary cities in America! But we need your help to stay in the fight. Anti-border politicians are doing everything in their power to bring this lawlessness to YOUR backyard. Oregon has a hotline set up for citizens to report violations of the state's sanctuary law. You read that right. It's not a hotline to report illegal aliens, but a hotline to report people for not doing enough to protect illegal aliens! The city of Seattle demanded a $100 million COVID relief fund for illegal aliens from Washington state. San Francisco's DA even created a special unit with the sole purpose of helping illegal aliens avoid deportation. And that's just the tip of the iceberg. Now, I know if you 're the patriot I think you are, this all sounds crazy to you. It sounds like something that could never happen in America. But that just isn't true. My name is Dale Wilcox, and I've been with the Immigration Reform Law Institute for eight years now because I believe that our nation must be able to defend its borders and uphold the rule of law. Our team has seen the effects of anti-border policies up close and personal - and that's why we work so hard to make sure the rest of America doesn't have to. In every single sanctuary city and county across the country, Americans are in more danger. It's no coincidence. After all, when you reward criminals, lawlessness is sure to follow. But I'm writing to you today because there's something you can do. To put it simply, the courts are our best bet. We must be prepared to take on the legal battles that will shape our nation, and we can't do that without your help. If you don't want the same reckless policies that overtook LA and New York introduced in your own community, I hope we can count on your urgent support. body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220908&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220908&amount=28]
Team,
Can you believe it? There are only TWO MONTHS to go until Election Day!
The finish line is in sight – so, what do we need to do between now and November 8th?
First things first: our ground game. We spent the summer building out volunteer networks in the new counties in the new 7th district – and now we’re putting them to use. Every weekend, we launch massive canvasses out of our campaign office or a community space in the new district. We gather volunteers together and then send them out to go knock on doors in strategic parts of the district. We’ve also built up our program at Michigan State, and have student organizers spreading the word about how easy it is to vote on campus! Want to volunteer with us? Sign up here! [https://www.mobilize.us/elissaforcongress/]
Ensuring our ads are seen everywhere around the new district is another huge priority. They’re one of the best ways to spread Elissa’s message to the folks in the new district that haven’t had a chance to meet her yet. We’ve had four ads go up on the air and online since July 5th ( see them all here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] ), and we’ll be launching more in the weeks to come. In exciting news, the 60-day window prior to the election, in which TV stations must give candidates lower rates to advertise, begins tomorrow. GOP super PACs have spent over $1 million *per week* in each of the last two weeks against me, with millions more in attack ads reserved over the next few weeks. Since TV stations set their own prices, they’ve majorly increased the cost of advertising in the last few weeks in preparation for rates to go down – definitely an unexpected road bump that we’ll be glad to see in the rear view window.
Finally, we have everyone’s least favorite task of the campaign home stretch: continuing to fundraise. We’ve spent the last year preparing to be competitive in these final months, which are by far the most expensive of the entire campaign. That money has gone into purchasing more ads, hiring additional organizers, printing campaign materials, and buying and distributing yard signs.
But, like that spike in ad prices we mentioned earlier, no matter how prepared we are, there are always unforeseen issues that pop up. Which is why we need to continue building the resources we need to be nimble, as we adapt to everything that gets thrown our way – and why we’re asking if you’d consider sending a contribution our way. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220908&amount=28] We’re in the home stretch, and we’ll be keeping our foot on the gas until November 8th!

This will be the last time you’ll hear from me before our midnight deadline, friend: **_[With exactly two months left until election day, will you contribute to my campaign’s $100,000 goal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50433654/365849538/-472610390?amount=25&refcode=20220908_f_4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjczNTBiOS1kMzJmLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CwXvfIX5KdOSXRlxRIKcIybJKAjv-Zi2H0apq6utWZc=)_**
To be frank, I don’t like asking for money, and I wish I didn’t have to. But unlike Gov. DeSantis, I’m not bankrolled by far-right, billionaire donors.
I’m proud of that fact, but it does mean I rely on this grassroots team to hit important goals like this one — **and with each goal we hit, we move closer to defeating DeSantis.**
And we must defeat Ron DeSantis. In fact, _The South Florida Sun Sentinel_ has said “the highest priority for Florida Democrats in 2022 must be to end the political career of Ron DeSantis” and that I’m the only candidate who can make it happen.
The threat that Ron DeSantis poses cannot be downplayed. Over the last few months, he’s...
1. Signed an extreme 15-week abortion ban into law with no exceptions for rape or incest, and doubled down on his anti-choice stance even before the US Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade...
2. Pledged to eliminate common sense gun safety measures...
3. Handed out _**$600 million**_ in tax refunds to Florida’s biggest corporations.

We have _**one chance**_ to deny DeSantis a second term, and that’s TWO months from now on Election Day 2022.
