subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f13d9ee654ce484abc48aeadc284f433&_e=tAHi_Ab5XOAS5AfuMXm4QK7gTqRCQm9-ucSaTKDSInNKsspc9YjsoESoHpnmfjikBjx8rMRllDx864R70rRJk6LpWB1WPlJx1ZyX7L4f2e8spe37jzB06l7DHYQ-QHb_bTPbyJkQgBCH1Ajp4jjesBhZwX_e5s3RjB3BVQMYCBFA2UkxpxT0iLWFQ2Ly4z0tuQfZtgQ3NgATHSCuvBwxB7PQvW3cnpUG0gVywaAwOXdJfzlHUp-lCp50aYgBbMV5arpoIgAXDkzT_qFOJEbYE5adBJBKIoQ0K_PBuTq0g8I4R3Bcbh8Titvb8lIVxsP98dw2l7QXqgvuMGFDXfoMioQLjcbaDt_QnPSqittE_Bi-Q_gzQRKcaVmCKd2H2S9M "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: Weekly Newsletter: SAFE-T Act is Dangerous Legislation
body:
KeithPekau.com |
---
| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=989acc226e&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

This week the Orland Park Village Board passed a resolution demanding a repeal of the “SAFE-T” Act. This is dangerous legislation that everyone in a position of public trust needs to speak out against.

First, it was passed in the middle of the night, with 40 minutes to read an 800-page bill, which is unacceptable.

As of January 21, 2023, the following things will go into effect:
* It abolishes cash bail for almost every offense. This includes, but is not limited to: kidnapping, armed robbery, second-degree murder, drug-induced homicide, aggravated DUI, threatening a public official, and aggravated fleeing and alluding.
* Offenders on electronic monitoring must be in violation for 48 hours before law enforcement can act. (They could almost drive to Alaska before we could even look for them).
* It denies victims their constitutional rights
* And keep this in mind, businesses and homeowners: Officers will no longer be allowed to remove trespassers from your residence or business. (Someone could decide to live in your shed, and all we can do is give them a ticket. You have to decide what level of force is required to remove them... and whether or not it’s legal.)

This is a massive threat to the residents of Orland Park, Cook County, and Illinois. I want to remind voters that several elected officials that will be on the ballot in Orland Park voted for this abomination. Senator Michael Hastings, Senator Emil Jones, and Representative Justin Slaughter all voted to put criminals ahead of the safety of law-abiding citizens and police.

In particular, Senator Hastings, who personally told me that this bill was horrible, and that there was no way he would vote for it. An outright lie.

I was glad to cast my vote for this resolution and demand the repeal of the Orwellian-named “SAFE-T Act.”

But it doesn’t end there.

There’s currently a bill in front of the Illinois House to remove school resource officers from our schools. The City of Chicago has already done this. I personally don’t want to see the City of Chicago become the standard for how we conduct public safety, because they’ve abandoned their police officers, abandoned their residents, and created a war-zone full of criminals.

There is also a bill to make fentanyl a misdemeanor in this state.

Let me remind you, at the federal-level, Sean Casten, voted against extending the federal ban on fentanyl. Fortunately, the ban passed.

It is additionally, worth noting that Casten co-sponsored the anti-police bill in the US House that would have eliminated qualified immunity for police officers. We already can’t fill vacancies in our police departments, this would aggravate the problem exponentially.

We all need to take a stand against these dangerous bills, and the politicians who advance them.

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_

# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
| **[CBS Chicago](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=03649c0ed1&e=7dd0b93d07): 9 dead, 47 wounded in Chicago shootings over Labor Day Weekend**
At least nine people are dead, and 47 others are wounded in shootings across Chicago over the Labor Day weekend. The ages of the victims range from 13 to 63.

clean_body: KeithPekau.com | | | | | | Peter, This week the Orland Park Village Board passed a resolution demanding a repeal of the “SAFE-T” Act. This is dangerous legislation that everyone in a position of public trust needs to speak out against. First, it was passed in the middle of the night, with 40 minutes to read an 800-page bill, which is unacceptable. As of January 21, 2023, the following things will go into effect: It abolishes cash bail for almost every offense. This includes, but is not limited to: kidnapping, armed robbery, second-degree murder, drug-induced homicide, aggravated DUI, threatening a public official, and aggravated fleeing and alluding. Offenders on electronic monitoring must be in violation for 48 hours before law enforcement can act. (They could almost drive to Alaska before we could even look for them). It denies victims their constitutional rights And keep this in mind, businesses and homeowners: Officers will no longer be allowed to remove trespassers from your residence or business. (Someone could decide to live in your shed, and all we can do is give them a ticket. You have to decide what level of force is required to remove them... and whether or not it’s legal.) This is a massive threat to the residents of Orland Park, Cook County, and Illinois. I want to remind voters that several elected officials that will be on the ballot in Orland Park voted for this abomination. Senator Michael Hastings, Senator Emil Jones, and Representative Justin Slaughter all voted to put criminals ahead of the safety of law-abiding citizens and police. In particular, Senator Hastings, who personally told me that this bill was horrible, and that there was no way he would vote for it. An outright lie. I was glad to cast my vote for this resolution and demand the repeal of the Orwellian-named “SAFE-T Act.” But it doesn’t end there. There’s currently a bill in front of the Illinois House to remove school resource officers from our schools. The City of Chicago has already done this. I personally don’t want to see the City of Chicago become the standard for how we conduct public safety, because they’ve abandoned their police officers, abandoned their residents, and created a war-zone full of criminals. There is also a bill to make fentanyl a misdemeanor in this state. Let me remind you, at the federal-level, Sean Casten, voted against extending the federal ban on fentanyl. Fortunately, the ban passed. It is additionally, worth noting that Casten co-sponsored the anti-police bill in the US House that would have eliminated qualified immunity for police officers. We already can’t fill vacancies in our police departments, this would aggravate the problem exponentially. We all need to take a stand against these dangerous bills, and the politicians who advance them. **Chabot Campaign: Landsman Staggeringly Out-of-Touch in Television Interview** _Democratic Candidate Doesn’t Consider Economy or Rising Costs Top Issues,__Refuses to Accept Responsibility for Lead Role in City Council Scandal, Misleads Voters on Support for Defunding Police_ _ _ **For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released the following statement on Greg Landsman’s [interview](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=667d84f14b0142f8aa5642e3449328b0&_e=1xPnpOyhuXeJBx5rvjU405XiprvfhOqhrSBvVcK65ScgJub7t_AqzNNvODf-wFxXkzbbfnz-ABiKy2p4Q6Uh69i5ow2PyvBPHSUzC2bQy2qnvtVGAzzM3r8DMN1SMryTtitr2Yr3BTVEUSi3J2zyP8Mo05FhtIl7p5DqvQnuu2cfDycdUofbdYMEZaSXejPzVgRqEF61tnL5bTgtiECmdCmZWPaxtk0Tyw3NCVg3W_46fOQ7ptxzsvyMQsOwkzZfdX7akshfZEHGF75RcsNQIRnoecJXQdqtK838lec6EO1HqmMJ3upPTTa3At79v8oi) with Spectrum News that aired Wednesday. “Former Nancy Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman has once again demonstrated that his priorities are staggeringly out-of-touch with the concerns and priorities of First District voters,” said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. “During the interview, Landsman said he wouldn’t place the economy or rising costs in his top three issues, proving yet again his complete disregard for the most pressing challenges facing hardworking families and small businesses in First District communities.” “Landsman’s lack of interest in improving the economy or addressing out-of-control inflation fits perfectly in line with his record of supporting tax hikes that increase the burden on families and small businesses and unbridled support for his former boss Nancy Pelosi and her extreme tax-and-spend agenda in Washington,” Gomez continued. “In addition, Landsman tried to mislead voters on his support for defunding the police. Landsman claimed to have a ‘perfect’ record on law enforcement during the interview but failed to mention that he wrote and championed a proposal on the City Council that WLWT called the ‘definition’ of defunding the police.” “Landsman also dodged responsibility for his central role in the ‘Gang of 5’ scandal that cost taxpayers $170,000,” Gomez added. “If Landsman took full accountability for his role in the scandal, he would have abided by the recommendation of a Hamilton County Judge that he resign and never run for public office again.” Read more about Landsman’s tax-hiking record and support for Nancy Pelosi’s extreme tax-and-spend agenda [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=667d84f14b0142f8aa5642e3449328b0&_e=1xPnpOyhuXeJBx5rvjU403ciXw8pwRpeXS9YbKpyYWSLaceKs-1BqKlO_IVjrUj--Khg2XTmxjL7EF9FWVixDo3p7xDNXuDQyvBLWu6x1J1YIqOrjswpCPxcby49EQSC6nrfiiS7c8CKsQeCaF-_0QtrHTbcKAe_94d8ez9XiLL9JW2dERr7v5g_dLpLJ1aRYZSJ9FI4mSKvUipWzfZaT3Exd9vqi4O2-0T4nsy2iAnDofR5rLGdcPHgtP-tLtMd8CoIDJichOmY75dEPXzMlnQzfY7GKAvKe4kOH8w5ELaIQHYy283Te17b0-OU5CEvwxqgvww86zD_9zcuDXkGq8PJrzosoHUWHRP3scFIzuQ%3D). Read more about Landsman’s support for defunding the police [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=667d84f14b0142f8aa5642e3449328b0&_e=1xPnpOyhuXeJBx5rvjU406Wc_tNhyItMu7xHMZMcmBLE9XvfbG-Lzo-JyOXhKLf-_LTnQEqZemyLfhXFfeGstR3pVP7qahy8QnMcVk3VKwz0vPNV7XHwqq-Tf-S4gXOuvVPh8Xokj8L-hNKA1fQVYl_VCrAVPS2f_mt9YjApJTA-q0UQ3KCJ1i_AHNABiTQNC0Ay47cW0uC_mS9VcE1ehyF4FzdC1trRTH-2iyiYdmj_nbKUK6ePDYQ96pLKX55Dl4AqhALGjBrwAgB0hHMNQSsHDIiVEVYj39Aamq1tiWdHoBOcREbx9XuVvWEjj0ponDkWh51cM_aMTFPcl4cz6w%3D%3D). Read more on Landsman’s role in corruption and scandal on the Cincinnati City Council [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=667d84f14b0142f8aa5642e3449328b0&_e=1xPnpOyhuXeJBx5rvjU403ciXw8pwRpeXS9YbKpyYWRAqmlRwPgXWapXHmJiV-y96tQPGodtghqL9zwuOS_4r918fj0UpHZ5a6MGt4TmEajUHWoqVaNPPMO5cSAVTkutjDTcZFbYl_ZqSZFJuiDfh43lQZctutpjDdM6yMqtkpxWjmWXf-0S6TPlYsZZElB_9oOWAEMFYZFDv_5jKXgx7AVl8Ltv7zYqhxBYKyTudkqSzK2eQlbh7o3Anu_einuB9kL3ZPltiMxoIa_rRGna7GESb17VF1rD6dKot_3lSD1olKtQzje-tVkBV66TGGtm1MqyKurdVvf3fwrSA2FPahEJNiTdM8C_o-vef1BtNGM%3D). ###

## 2 months out from the midterms GOP Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel joins me on Beyond the Briefing...
Ronna has been the chair of the RNC since 2017 and we talked about how she got there, what it was like to grow up in a politically influential family, being a working mom, Trump’s support, how the RNC will handle the potential for a 2024 presidential primary, their plans for the upcoming midterms, Ronna’s future plans and more. Lots of great insight into how the party is run, Ronna’s journey climbing the ranks, the Donald Trump not everyone gets to see and more:
| [Download it here](https://seanspicer.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d009170fb4604b5974b5521bd&id=13f45ddc62&e=f6564bbe3b)

## Introducing: Latinos.vote
Explosive! That’s the only way we can describe what’s happening with the growth in the Latino community and the impact we’re about to have in political campaigns around the country during the midterms.For decades we have worked – on both sides of the aisle – trying to prepare our respective political parties for what is happening now. Sometimes they’ve listened, sometimes they haven’t. Along the way and with thousands of campaigns under our belt, we’ve seen what works and what doesn’t.The Latino Vote website — [**www.latinos.vote**](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=1cc8aeed28&e=5bd167f239) — was created to share those insights with a country undergoing tremendous change. The complexion of our society is changing, our politics are changing and our campaigns are changing. The Latino Vote website was created to provide you with a place
to see those changes documented daily.We’ll be bringing you all the day’s news from the country’s newspapers covering Latino politics.We’ll be bringing you thoughtful op-ed pieces from opinion leaders in the Latino community.We’ll be bringing you the latest polling data covering our community and offering analysis, commentary, advice and criticism where we think it’s needed.The Latino voter will determine who controls the house and senate in the 2022 midterms and who will be the President in 2024. On The Latino Vote podcast and on this new website, we explain why.America is changing. Latinos are the second largest ethnic voting bloc in the country and growing fast. We’re here to document the story of that change and we looking forward to you joining us on the journey.**Mike Madrid and Chuck Rocha**

Peters issues the following statement following her not guilty plea: **" Fortunately the Constitution of the United States entitles you to a trial by a jury of your peers, not political hatchet men clamoring for their next position in the Biden administration. Six months ago my legal team asked to present the very evidence I've been accused of sharing to the Grand Jury, and that request was denied. body:
Support the labor movement and the fight for climate justice.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220908-mu.RGhAiS&refcode=em20220908-3372-P_FND_EXP_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3372%2E2526796%2Ebrx1Os)
We’ve come a long way from 2017 when Alexandria first publicly referenced something called "The Green New Deal" in a tweet that garnered 7 likes and 0 retweets.1
Today, the Green New Deal has reshaped the national conversation around climate change. Where reducing carbon emissions and creating jobs were once seen as at odds, the GND promises to create millions of union jobs while building the infrastructure our country will need for clean energy. And first up for those jobs will be workers from traditional energy sectors like coal and fracking — that’s what a just transition looks like.
[We need your support to make a labor-centered vision for climate change a reality. Would you chip in $3 today to help us achieve a Green New Deal?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220908-mu.RGhAiS&refcode=em20220908-3372-P_FND_EXP_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3372%2E2526796%2Ebrx1Os)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220908-mu.RGhAiS&refcode=em20220908-3372-P_FND_EXP_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3372%2E2526796%2Ebrx1Os)**
Some of the largest unions in the country have backed the GND — from Service Employees International Union (SEIU), to National Nurses United, to the Association of Flight Attendants-CWA (among many more!). The GND enjoys support from working people everywhere, in part because renewable energy could employ more than 40 million people by 2050.2
The GND has done more than just reshape the conversation. In August, the President signed into law the largest-ever investment in climate change. The money will go towards creating 9 million new jobs in clean energy, clean manufacturing, environmental protection and green transportation. And this Spring, Congress passed millions in federal funding for 60 Green New Deal certified community projects — all of which will create jobs reducing carbon emissions and making our communities more resilient to extreme weather.3
[We’re making progress on the GND, but to stand up to fossil fuel interests, and deliver for working people and our climate, we need your help. Can you spare $3 today to keep Alexandria in Congress, fighting for the workers of this country and their bid to advance the Green New Deal? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220908-mu.RGhAiS&refcode=em20220908-3372-P_FND_EXP_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3372%2E2526796%2Ebrx1Os)
It has been our pleasure to share the importance of our continued support for the labor movement with you this week, and we’re not done yet! Stay tuned for more union wins and explainers on how they make our vision for socialism stronger.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

But now, Senator Joe Manchin is trying to jam through a "side deal" in the Senate that could fast-track the pipeline and imperil these communities—and our livable future. **We just released a new blog with the top four reasons Senate Democrats must stand against the Mountain Valley Pipeline.[_Read up about all the dirty details now._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4349?t=3&akid=13097%2E53494%2EPZCKgL)** | [READ UP](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4349?t=4&akid=13097%2E53494%2EPZCKgL)

This project is a textbook example of environmental injustice. The Mountain Valley Pipeline would treat Appalachia as a sacrifice zone, harming low-income, rural, and majority-elder communities and encroaching on sacred Indigenous sites.
It would also lock us into decades of new pollution, exacerbating the climate crisis and veering us further away from President Biden's climate goals.
[_**That's just the tip of the iceberg. Read our blog to find out all the dirty details about the Mountain Valley Pipeline—and then get ready to fight for our frontline communities.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4349?t=5&akid=13097%2E53494%2EPZCKgL)

The convention gave me a chance to lay out my vision for One Georgia to
some of our party’s most committed advocates and activists — and to
celebrate the diverse, historic slate of Democratic nominees for all our
statewide offices.

My vision for opportunity in Georgia means that your background and zip
code shouldn’t determine success. We’re building a stronger Georgia where
everyone has the opportunity to succeed and access to the resources they
need.

Summerhill Small Business Saturday (09/03/2022)

I heard from local business leaders about what issues mattered to them.

As an entrepreneur, I have always sought to invest in and protect small
businesses across the state of Georgia. As governor, I will steer Georgia
to becoming a state where everyone can move up and move forward — to
thrive, not just survive.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220908_B3_TrailUpdate_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1006&akid=5939%2E1862389%2EP9QT0N ]Derek,

DUAW Labor Day Picnic (09/05/2022)

Finally, we visited Fulton County to meet with union members and activists

Building a fair, thriving workforce across Georgia is a significant part
of my vision. Economic justice is paramount to the movement we’re building
— and my vision for One Georgia means protecting workers.

Peter —

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution directly to my campaign to defeat Ron Johnson in Wisconsin. Please give me a chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so important.

Here is the truth:

At the end of this month, we face a critical FEC fundraising deadline, and we have some very big goals to meet before it ends.

The reason this matters is because right now, Ron Johnson’s campaign and his allies are flooding the airwaves with ads. We have ads up too, but not to the level of everyone trying to beat us.

So tomorrow, my campaign is going to make a few important budget decisions. And honestly, what we can afford to do, and what we can’t afford to do, could be the difference in this race.

This campaign is funded by lots of people making online donations, but we need more people doing their part. We need you, Peter. Today if you can.

Hello Peter, my name is Sylvia Garcia, and I represent TX-29 in the Houston area in the US Congress. When I first got word of Michelle and the movement she was building in South Texas, I knew she was the kind of representative I would want beside me in Washington. That’s why I was proud to give Michelle my endorsement and full support back in March. Then, I joined her on the ground to talk to voters at the doors in TX-15. I could feel the energy on the ground, and how excited folks were for Michelle and her vision. It’s clear that the people are ready for her bold, progressive path forward. I became one of the first two Latinas to represent the State of Texas in Congress and look forward to seeing a historic win in November, with Michelle joining us as the 3rd Democratic Latina in Congress from Texas. Juntos, we are going to empower Latino voters in South Texas, bring our families, friends and _vecinos_ out to the polls, and defend our home! Michelle’s and my story aren’t too different. I grew up in South Texas with hard-working parents, one of ten children, making ends meet. She too grew up in South Texas raised by parents with that same spirit. Our parents had a dream that their daughters could grow up, get an education, and have a fair shot at the American Dream.
It is the same dream South Texas working families today have for their children. Michelle lives that dream. She has a deep connection to the district — to the people she grew up alongside and now will be fighting for in the US Congress. She knows her constituents and the issues they care about because they are her neighbors, friends, and her _familia_.
We are building a movement that will reclaim the power of Latino voters in South Texas — and we need you with us! We need to keep the American Dream alive for all our children. We need to put people over politics.
**Juntos, we can with Michelle Vallejo.**[**Consider joining me in supporting her in this critical election with a donation today.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wj0IZ8dCDR2RipYyjhotr5NGarYqydV5ZSt7xfV52lIyoyg3mF-7UMvO6MPDdSEtpbAW5Oo5-VufwizEURDgyX-Z4t-AJnF6PdXoaIL6CuYhP618q2HQYlT4oxP1sMpz9C3NES8r1rEMwteB1rNYDy4rFFe80kKPNNKlCWzUp6UuVC44Rmu2Z26-vO423vZPLFLPLIoL0WiuTtwMzXjQ2I2CM2JAyTKcLnznIV983d59fRdNoddedcNHo3DMBYkA-J3ZwbJk1JPpu5iefbJM_usFFj21VGxlDX4ZyJ9hxMkUlKAlhQdv31BkAabi3EPS7hdf5N4PxtF9cMoRL-EGvDWIjb5pt6uPHgwBM_LeK8Xg/3pa/ctoRFqwuSnybDYPCH-DUmw/h8/_3N1VTQlznqlR6np9L1kAjqLh5Nz36Z022FhTmJenxo)

clean_body: | | | Hello Peter, my name is Sylvia Garcia, and I represent TX-29 in the Houston area in the US Congress. When I first got word of Michelle and the movement she was building in South Texas, I knew she was the kind of representative I would want beside me in Washington. That’s why I was proud to give Michelle my endorsement and full support back in March. Then, I joined her on the ground to talk to voters at the doors in TX-15. I could feel the energy on the ground, and how excited folks were for Michelle and her vision. It’s clear that the people are ready for her bold, progressive path forward. I became one of the first two Latinas to represent the State of Texas in Congress and look forward to seeing a historic win in November, with Michelle joining us as the 3rd Democratic Latina in Congress from Texas. Juntos, we are going to empower Latino voters in South Texas, bring our families, friends and vecinos out to the polls, and defend our home! If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly to Michelle Vallejo: | Michelle’s and my story aren’t too different. I grew up in South Texas with hard-working parents, one of ten children, making ends meet. She too grew up in South Texas raised by parents with that same spirit. Our parents had a dream that their daughters could grow up, get an education, and have a fair shot at the American Dream. It is the same dream South Texas working families today have for their children. Michelle lives that dream. She has a deep connection to the district — to the people she grew up alongside and now will be fighting for in the US Congress. She knows her constituents and the issues they care about because they are her neighbors, friends, and her familia. We are building a movement that will reclaim the power of Latino voters in South Texas — and we need you with us! We need to keep the American Dream alive for all our children. We need to put people over politics. Juntos, we can with Michelle Vallejo. Muchas gracias, Rep. Friend,

We're now only two months away from the election, so most emails will be "political": talking about events (like the campaign meet+greet TONIGHT at the Chico Democratic HQ at 5 pm!) However, the goal of being elected is to enact positive policy change! Let's not forget what we're fighting FOR. So, on that note, let's talk forestry. Specifically, using biomass for energy. Also, this is a rather long email -- so if you're not interested in forest policy, feel free to stop reading. _The New York Times_ had a great article yesterday on **[logging in Europe's old-growth forests](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDBDPv4fFWda8QsNYKd9TFU-8QR6SyheQlIgprRzn45wYIjtacAcbH4fimeZvelIFPUYzcPKAc6FbDrAxDwuUwwYC7FQO8BoeuPPL749K67XV1aW2C5_7mjAY3SREUmOxWjHWtXwcV8AkiSBCxaxS4mCIXu04DhuszE0NiHnRMsZj-WdyLU1dwvnNKugazJz7WGVdazwN8WNMH0ROGptgce_VWj0u8rOsPUcL7XMRyoUqeAHBT9l7GdzMQa8-Yyy-q4OtJn9NB3iv8pX5Zuy18hDF1F2Gt4EybxTjWeDlt4NHfbN2Pw5sXp6qFS6qDeEv0tjT8AexidUg3aNcq54MLZoj8Y3b4akZUh8xxhs1ZALJ/3pa/V0fUaO4NSQms7vpf2zsfOw/h0/iPo02jywR3RAOZiv22U1bkcgBENL4mLPJMGF2r1OLi8)**. Put simply: Europe is facing an energy crunch due to the Russian-Ukrainian war, and eastern European countries are cutting trees to convert to pellets for use in western European countries for power. There are a couple of points here:

1.) Wood pellets are a good source of power, and easy to ship long distance 2.) Europe shouldn't be cutting down old growth forests to grind into pellets. But while Europe doesn't have a lot of excess biomass (trees and brush) in its forests, California does! One of the legacies of clear-cutting is that the next generation of trees come in much denser (300-400 trees per acre) than a "natural" forest (around 100 trees per acre). Without older trees "shading out" their competitors, every tree grows at the same time and rate. That overcrowding is one of the reasons California forests are so vulnerable to climate change and fire. Fixing California's forests will require thinning, and demand for wood pellets in Europe means that there is a market for that fuel. Sending wood pellets to Europe will make Californian forests healthier, reduce fire risk, AND help Europeans survive the cut in Russian natural gas. **To that end, the government should be subsidizing and encouraging the construction of biomass facilities throughout the North State to convert more wood into pellets for export.** At the same time, the US Forest Service needs a long term, sustainable thinning plan that will supply these plants while protecting the essential character and long-term health of our national forests. Energy security is national security, and our forests are a key part of the solution. Increasing biomass pellet production here in the North State would be a win for our forests that need thinning and a win for European forests that need protection. It's also a win for our rural communities threatened by fire, and a win for Europe facing real energy insecurity. There's a real opportunity here, we just need a Congressman who will step up and lead, rather than sit back and complain like Doug LaMalfa.

**[We have a chance to bring some innovative ideas to the North State by ousting Doug LaMalfa. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Choice is officially on the MI ballot
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220908_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220908_2&amount=28]
Team,
Today, the Michigan Supreme Court did the right thing and ruled that the Reproductive Freedom for All initiative will be on the general election ballot.
In addition to codifying the Roe standard in the state constitution, the ballot proposal would also guarantee Michigan women the right to access contraception, the right to receive fertility treatment, and the right to determine their own pre- and post-partum care—all issues that the United States Supreme Court noted are potentially up for debate in future cases.
In my district, while many women identify as pro-life, they have taken pains to engage me on this issue. Though many make clear that they would never personally have an abortion, they also have never walked in another woman’s shoes and therefore would never dictate to other women what they can or can’t do with their lives.
That’s the choice voters will face this fall: In Michigan, do we want the Roe standard or the 1931 abortion ban as law in our state? Michiganders—not the government, and not politicians like my opponent—deserve to have the final say on personal choices. Thanks to the Court’s ruling, they will.

If you read one email from me this campaign, it should be this one. They found hand grenades. Dozens of firearms. Bullet-proof vests. 142 pounds of meth. And one million fentanyl pills. | | |
---
| | Peter, They found hand grenades. Dozens of firearms. Bullet-proof vests. 142 pounds of meth. **And one million fentanyl pills.** All of this wasn’t found at some drug lab in Mexico – **it was found in an Albuquerque neighborhood during a raid by the feds just last week.** If you read one email from me this campaign, it should be this one. Because what happened last week explains how Governor Lujan Grisham has made our crime problem so bad in New Mexico These raids were targeting Sureno gang members with ties to the Mexican Sinaloa Cartel who are operating in New Mexico. Why are these gang members here? Well, according to the gang members themselves, it’s because New Mexico’s laws are so weak. And how do the drugs get here? The fentanyl crosses our wide-open border. **While the governors in Texas and Arizona have deployed their national guard and law enforcement to the border, MLG removed the National Guard from our border and made New Mexico a sanctuary state**. No wonder cartel operatives were found with **ONE MILLION FENTANYL PILLS.** Here’s what one confidential informant told the feds, according to court filings: **_“A lot of California Sureños were not returning to California due to tougher laws there....New Mexico was ‘an easy place to live ... and be us’ (Sureños)._** **That’s the result of having a Catch and Release governor who believes in open borders and provides sanctuary to cartel operatives. ** You see, at least California has a “3-strikes you’re out” law. But not in New Mexico. In fact, not only do we have weak laws in New Mexico, but MLG has ordered the early release of convicted criminals from prison. **Now the prison population is down 20% since she took office...all while crime is skyrocketing.** We must change this. As governor, I will deploy the National Guard to the border and create a Border Strike Force to go after the cartels. And my crime plan will toughen laws, repeal the Sanctuary State policy, and end Catch and Release in New Mexico.
But none of this will happen if we can’t inform voters of the truth about crime. **That’s why I need your most generous support today.[Your contribution will help us communicate with voters across New Mexico.](http://links.markronchetti.com/u/click?_t=b07bd752cdb64edc94e23391776d0f53&_m=42f97a420fc04ddf8cd2d2a1e2012c0d&_e=s_4SnFFoNyiUSYSu6IrOOGmpzLHaq-89gyiVQ7VcsJoHnp17uv7TGuTEkqcOQtq2BWPlU5KVW4KBBH2M4aLs_QZiKTs4U4hwt_04Uo4ZdmmK2jACmah_Y6t-gV5vDn9BCtqR5M0_rcUezhFjJF0QBauZNjsMM0v9Q9SZpq9cgZuGypStUGVrEjV7PSPvI_p9ybQO1-4h0K9Yih7n9RNRkTvZj_KmXHE_dhUKrUVXQlQYyGrSqzvj8aEBadnyt-iG7I_3SqxoC74P2YusTkFo25Zc1GiXd9imayCJc2411t5Dvw6KEzaz9DmvR4iSOgzHczqYH74oQncTQAus9UI9J4r4_vT2Y_D9QI-GDltU47YzlJoZCTanjnQYXbtFcXmqX32MUPAxE3EgiMqmlEPLm9lGR_SNBdOYpvEW17NdRhfv2bCuBUgHuwslxT5nJNMbglGfmus3oHa9YrT9QrPN6A%3D%3D)**

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=f6d82d94319e4141b5f7e257c13308d5&_e=X07o57z7dHEVgA0NSot1rBAZZICdVzf-WrBpTqi4pO5FzzH_YpaDidv-0ZAWoCzMflZp2jRyR_Ocd_E42mrxlBBs0lLV61YUYlac-_TqqMNuNYGwYC_2wDYQopDDJV2q6qN0oDKlZ1ruVW0TdqiQwvITm05w8n8JZu0v05jxDG5zf3hDlv740Qn9V3aly3KshNOdPdjyO_croj9rqx6RsWjginzeDSmgjybGqAnHwQCEHegJ6M71_EsKq2F6ySPjblMYgohs5X3zP1z52BAZjAUc2NNLwTfwSTyOAMOOMDx52hHuHq6OArUkiLrkMOihHAobDx_plU0PNlRDki7MJWeOzp--DKjnATIYU7yynNEiw-BsRT0-Fysoz3UNT7ln "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

name: John Fetterman
subject: One test I’m proud to fail
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
The NRA has already launched ads supporting Dr. Oz
#
Omg. I failed a test, Derek.
But I’m pretty sure you’ll be proud of me for failing it 😁
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7175&refcode2=7175_434096_x5NaIz&akid=7175%2E434096%2Ex5NaIz)
Yep, I got an F rating from the NRA’s Political Victory Fund. Unlike Dr. Oz, who is endorsed by the NRA-PVF.
Our stark difference when it comes to gun violence prevention — the difference being that I support basic safety measures + Oz doesn’t — has made our race a flashpoint for the NRA. 🙄
They’ve already launched ads to support Oz + we know from experience the NRA has million$ to spend when it comes to buying elections.
**And, quite frankly, Derek, our country can’t afford another NRA-backed, bought-and-paid-for senator.**
**[If we’re going to win up against another corporate PAC supporting our opponent, we need all hands on deck. Please, consider rushing a $5 donation to help my team fight back against the NRA + Dr. Oz.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7175&refcode2=7175_434096_x5NaIz&akid=7175%2E434096%2Ex5NaIz)**
**[Rush $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7175&refcode2=7175_434096_x5NaIz&akid=7175%2E434096%2Ex5NaIz)**
When I talk about gun violence, I want you to know why this issue is so personal to me.
**On my right arm I have nine different dates tattooed.** These are the dates when people were killed through violence in Braddock while I served as Mayor, starting in 2006. _Seven out of nine were gun deaths._
My first tattoo came after January 16, 2006. It was my second week on the job as mayor after winning my election by a single vote. I received a call and was summoned to a police crime scene where a pizza delivery man had been robbed and killed by gun violence.
Every time Braddock lost someone was the worst feeling in the world, Derek.
In my 13 years as mayor, I worked with the community to take on gun violence and other important issues that Braddock faced every day. **One of my proudest achievements as Mayor was when Braddock went five and a half years without a gun death.**
The United States is the only country that sees this level of mass shootings, and we have the power to end it.
To be clear, I’m a gun owner, and I’ve been around guns my whole life.
And I want what an overwhelming majority of Americans, including the majority of gun owners, want — which is common sense gun safety measures. We need universal background checks, red flag laws, and more proactive efforts to get illegal guns off our streets.
Yet, these beliefs are being used against me by the NRA to drive support for Dr. Oz, who opposes many of these popular safety measures, including a universal background check plan.
**[Enough is enough. We cannot let the NRA help Oz buy this seat. Please, help our grassroots campaign stand up and fight back against this special interest money by rushing a donation today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7175&refcode2=7175_434096_x5NaIz&akid=7175%2E434096%2Ex5NaIz)**
**[Rush $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220908-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220908-7175&refcode2=7175_434096_x5NaIz&akid=7175%2E434096%2Ex5NaIz)**
Gun violence prevention is personal for me, and every time we delay real action, we’re only counting down the hours until the next tragedy.
Thank you,
❤️ John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

clean_body: The NRA has already launched ads supporting Dr. Oz Omg. I failed a test, Derek. But I’m pretty sure you’ll be proud of me for failing it 😁 Yep, I got an F rating from the NRA’s Political Victory Fund. Unlike Dr. Oz, who is endorsed by the NRA-PVF. Our stark difference when it comes to gun violence prevention — the difference being that I support basic safety measures + Oz doesn’t — has made our race a flashpoint for the NRA. 🙄 They’ve already launched ads to support Oz + we know from experience the NRA has million$ to spend when it comes to buying elections. And, quite frankly, Derek, our country can’t afford another NRA-backed, bought-and-paid-for senator. When I talk about gun violence, I want you to know why this issue is so personal to me. On my right arm I have nine different dates tattooed. These are the dates when people were killed through violence in Braddock while I served as Mayor, starting in 2006. Seven out of nine were gun deaths. My first tattoo came after January 16, 2006. It was my second week on the job as mayor after winning my election by a single vote. I received a call and was summoned to a police crime scene where a pizza delivery man had been robbed and killed by gun violence. Every time Braddock lost someone was the worst feeling in the world, Derek. In my 13 years as mayor, I worked with the community to take on gun violence and other important issues that Braddock faced every day. One of my proudest achievements as Mayor was when Braddock went five and a half years without a gun death. The United States is the only country that sees this level of mass shootings, and we have the power to end it. To be clear, I’m a gun owner, and I’ve been around guns my whole life. And I want what an overwhelming majority of Americans, including the majority of gun owners, want — which is common sense gun safety measures. We need universal background checks, red flag laws, and more proactive efforts to get illegal guns off our streets. Yet, these beliefs are being used against me by the NRA to drive support for Dr. Oz, who opposes many of these popular safety measures, including a universal background check plan. Gun violence prevention is personal for me, and every time we delay real action, we’re only counting down the hours until the next tragedy. Thank you, ❤️ John John Fetterman Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

Remember to Get Out and VOTE for Kevin Smith on Tuesday, September 13th. For polling locations click here! -->**[VOTE.GOP](vote.gop)** **_From the Desk of Governor Benson_**
**I 'm so grateful for the strong support Republicans gave me as Governor. **

name: Joe Kent
subject: DC Event, Tuesday Night!
body:
Hey,
I'm having an event in Washington, DC, on Tuesday night and want to invite you to attend. I don't think I'll be out of Washington State very much between now and the election, so I'm really looking forward to meeting my out-of-state supporters on this trip.
The event is at the Warf at the Boardwalk Bar and Arcade from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM on Tuesday, September 18.
And I'm lucky to be joined by two great fellow patriots, Congressmen Scott Perry and Troy Nehls.
You can get tickets and all the information at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/DC](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/OSu2gSY5e1WkZg48wBroHQ/763PLtQvT3KEua334gTLAk5Q).
I've attached a formal invite and a social media graphic you can share.
And if you can't make it, you can also help us out with a direct contribution at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/v9PyyKgo4FtyHwSx1VnsWA/763PLtQvT3KEua334gTLAk5Q).
Look forward to seeing you there.
Respectfully,
Joe

I want to make sure you have the facts on my opponent, Kari Lake when it comes to the right to a safe, legal abortion.

|
---
| Peter,

I want to make sure you have the facts on my far-right opponent, Kari Lake when it comes to the right to a safe, legal abortion.
* Kari Lake has voiced support for Arizona’s Civil War-era abortion law — which criminalizes abortion in our state — calling it “great.”
* She has said that abortion pills should not be legal.
* She has promised that as governor, she would sign extreme anti-abortion legislation into law “in a heartbeat.”

That is where Kari Lake stands. Now, I want to be very clear about where I stand on this issue:

**I am unwavering in my support of reproductive freedom. As Arizona’s next governor, I will use my veto pen to block any legislation that further compromises the right to choose. And I will do everything in my power to secure women’s rights for the next generation.**

She has promised that as governor, she would sign extreme anti-abortion legislation into law “in a heartbeat.” That is where Kari Lake stands. Now, I want to be very clear about where I stand on this issue: I am unwavering in my support of reproductive freedom. As Arizona’s next governor, I will use my veto pen to block any legislation that further compromises the right to choose.
